articles.title: 拜仁慕尼黑2：1擊敗阿士東維拉　逾3.8萬人啟德主場館觀賽
articles.summary: 喺啟德主場館，拜仁慕尼黑踢2：1贏咗阿士東維拉，超過3.8萬人入場睇波。

levels.text: 琴晚喺啟德主場館，德國隊拜仁慕尼黑踢2：1贏咗英國隊阿士東維拉，超過3.8萬人入場睇波。上半場拜仁先入一球，領先1：0。落到下半場，兩隊都換咗好多人，拜仁再入多一球，變成2：0。維拉之後追返一球，最後拜仁贏一球完場。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, German team Bayern Munich beat English team Aston Villa 2-1, with over 38,000 people coming to watch. In the first half Bayern scored first, leading 1-0. In the second half both teams made many substitutions, and Bayern scored another goal, making it 2-0. Villa then pulled one back, and in the end Bayern won by one goal at full time.

levels.text: 琴晚喺啟德主場館，上演咗一場季前熱身賽，德甲拜仁慕尼黑踢2：1贏咗英超阿士東維拉，賽事吸引超過3.8萬人入場睇波。上半場37分鐘，比索夫用左腳開罰球，金玟哉頂頭鎚入波，拜仁半場領先1：0。下半場兩隊都換咗好多人，後備上場嘅路爾斯迪亞斯喺73分鐘射入，拜仁擴大比數。維拉之後全力反攻，祖奧高美斯喺83分鐘射入，追到1：2。之後艾巴咸有機會頂頭鎚，但畀拜仁門將紐亞撲走，最後拜仁維持一球優勢贏波。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, a pre-season warm-up match was staged, in which German Bundesliga side Bayern Munich beat English Premier League side Aston Villa 2-1, with the match drawing over 38,000 people to watch. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick with his left foot and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead at the break. In the second half both teams made many substitutions, and substitute Luis Diaz scored in the 73rd minute to extend Bayern's lead. Villa then went all-out on the counter-attack, and Joao Gomes scored in the 83rd minute to close the gap to 1-2. Afterwards Elghamran (Abraham) had a chance to head one in, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer, and in the end Bayern held on to their one-goal advantage to win.

levels.text: 琴晚喺啟德主場館，上演咗一場足球峰會季前熱身賽。德甲拜仁慕尼黑以2：1擊敗英超阿士東維拉，賽事吸引超過3.8萬人入場觀賽。上半場37分鐘，比索夫用左腳開出罰球，金玟哉頂頭鎚入波，拜仁半場領先1：0。兩隊喺下半場分別作出多個換人調動，後備上場嘅路爾斯迪亞斯喺禁區左路射遠柱，皮球擦楣底入網，喺73分鐘為拜仁擴大比數。落後兩球嘅維拉全力反撲，祖奧高美斯喺83分鐘喺禁區頂遠射入網，為維拉追至1：2嘅接近比數。艾巴咸之後有頭鎚攻門機會，但畀拜仁門將紐亞撲走。最後拜仁維持一球優勢完場，勝出賽事。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, a Football Festival pre-season warm-up match was staged. German Bundesliga side Bayern Munich beat English Premier League side Aston Villa 2-1, with the match drawing over 38,000 people to watch. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick with his left foot and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead at the break. Both teams made several substitutions in the second half, and substitute Luis Diaz, from the left of the box, shot at the far post, the ball grazing the underside of the crossbar into the net, extending Bayern's lead in the 73rd minute. Two goals down, Villa counter-attacked with all their might, and Joao Gomes scored from a header in the box (long-range shot) in the 83rd minute, pulling Villa back to a close 1-2. Abraham later had a heading chance on goal, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer. In the end Bayern held on to their one-goal advantage at full time to win the match.

levels.text: 昨晚在啟德主場館，舉行了一場季前熱身賽。德甲球隊拜仁慕尼黑以2：1擊敗英超球隊阿士東維拉，吸引超過3.8萬人入場觀看。上半場37分鐘，比索夫開出罰球，金玟哉頂頭鎚入球，拜仁以1：0領先。下半場兩隊都換了不少人。後備上場的路爾斯迪亞斯在73分鐘再入一球，令拜仁領先2：0。維拉全力反攻，祖奧高美斯在83分鐘入球，追到1：2。之後艾巴咸有機會頂頭鎚，但被拜仁門將紐亞撲走。最後拜仁保持一球優勢，贏得比賽。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, a pre-season warm-up match was held. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead. In the second half both teams made quite a few substitutions. Substitute Luis Diaz scored again in the 73rd minute, giving Bayern a 2-0 lead. Villa counter-attacked with all their might, and Joao Gomes scored in the 83rd minute to close to 1-2. Afterwards Abraham had a chance to head one in, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer. In the end Bayern kept their one-goal advantage and won the match.

levels.text: 晚上在啟德主場館上演的足球峰會季前熱身賽，德甲拜仁慕尼黑2：1擊敗英超阿士東維拉，賽事吸引超過3.8萬人入場。 上半場37分鐘，比索夫左腳開出罰球，金玟哉頭鎚頂入，拜仁半場領先1：0。 兩隊在下半場分別作出多個換人調動，後備入替的路爾斯迪亞斯禁區左路射遠柱，皮球擦楣底入網，為拜仁在73分鐘擴大比數。 落後兩球的維拉全力反撲，祖奧高美斯83分鐘在禁區頂遠射入網，為維拉追至1：2的接近比數。艾巴咸及後有頭鎚攻門機會，但被拜仁門將紐亞撲走。 最終拜仁維持一球優勢完場，勝出賽事。

In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick with his left foot and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead at the break. Both teams made several substitutions in the second half, and substitute Luis Diaz shot at the far post from the left of the box, the ball grazing the underside of the crossbar into the net, extending Bayern's lead in the 73rd minute. Two goals down, Villa counter-attacked with all their might, and Joao Gomes scored from a long-range shot in the box in the 83rd minute, pulling Villa back to a close 1-2. Abraham later had a heading chance on goal, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer. In the end Bayern held on to their one-goal advantage at full time to win the match.

articles.title: 李家超鼓勵保險業界開發跨境養老和醫療保險產品　便利灣區居民
articles.summary: 李家超叫保險公司開發跨境養老同醫療保險，方便灣區居民。

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席保險界活動時話，鼓勵各公司開發跨境養老同醫療保險，方便灣區居民。政府會繼續同內地部門傾，令有香港保單嘅人得到更好嘅售後支援，等兩地保險市場可以互通。佢仲想香港善用科技，做好風險管理。
levels.text_en: At an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages companies to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep talking with mainland departments so that people holding Hong Kong policies get better after-sales support, letting the two places' insurance markets connect. He also wants Hong Kong to make good use of technology and do risk management well.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一個保險界活動致辭時話，鼓勵業界開發跨境養老同醫療保險產品，方便灣區居民。政府會繼續同內地部門密切溝通，為持有香港保單嘅居民提供更好嘅售後支援，令兩地保險市場互通。佢又話已經促成七宗巨災債券發行，總額約六十二億港元，支持內地同環球市場管理風險。佢仲想爭取更多海內外企業喺香港成立自保保險公司，同推動業界善用人工智能同保險科技。
levels.text_en: Giving a speech at an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep in close communication with mainland departments to provide better after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, connecting the two places' insurance markets. He also said the government has facilitated the issuance of seven catastrophe bonds, totaling about HK$6.2 billion, supporting risk management in the mainland and global markets. He also wants to attract more domestic and overseas enterprises to set up self-insurance (captive) companies in Hong Kong, and to push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一項保險業界活動致辭時話，鼓勵業界開發跨境養老同醫療保險產品，方便灣區居民。政府會繼續同內地部門密切溝通，為持有香港保單嘅居民提供更完善嘅售後支援，促進兩地保險市場互聯互通。佢話，政府為保險相連證券設立專屬規管制度，並推出資助計劃，至今已促成七宗巨災債券發行，總額約六十二億港元，支持內地同環球市場管理風險。佢又提到業界善用香港作為國際航運中心嘅優勢，成立獨立嘅航運專項風險池，至今已有超過八百艘船隻受保。佢仲想爭取更多海內外企業喺香港成立自保保險公司，並推動業界善用人工智能同保險科技。
levels.text_en: Giving a speech at an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep in close communication with mainland departments to provide more comprehensive after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, promoting interconnection of the two places' insurance markets. He said the government has set up a dedicated regulatory regime for insurance-linked securities and launched a funding scheme, so far facilitating the issuance of seven catastrophe bonds totaling about HK$6.2 billion, supporting risk management in the mainland and global markets. He also mentioned that the sector has made good use of Hong Kong's advantage as an international shipping center, setting up an independent shipping-specific risk pool, with over 800 vessels now insured. He also wants to attract more domestic and overseas enterprises to set up captive insurance companies in Hong Kong, and to push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一個保險業界活動時致辭。他鼓勵業界開發跨境養老和醫療保險產品，方便大灣區居民。政府會繼續和內地部門溝通，為持有香港保單的居民提供更好的售後支援，令兩地保險市場互通。他說，政府設立了相關的規管制度，並推出資助計劃，至今已促成七宗巨災債券發行，總額約六十二億港元。業界也善用香港航運中心的優勢，成立航運風險池，至今已有超過八百艘船隻受保。他還希望爭取更多企業在香港成立自保保險公司，並推動業界善用人工智能和保險科技。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee gave a speech at an insurance industry event. He encouraged the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep communicating with mainland departments to provide better after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, connecting the two places' insurance markets. He said the government has set up the relevant regulatory regime and launched a funding scheme, so far facilitating the issuance of seven catastrophe bonds totaling about HK$6.2 billion. The sector has also made good use of Hong Kong's shipping-center advantage, setting up a shipping risk pool, with over 800 vessels now insured. He also hopes to attract more enterprises to set up captive insurance companies in Hong Kong, and to push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一項保險業界的活動致辭時表示，鼓勵業界開發跨境養老和醫療保險產品，便利灣區居民，政府會繼續與內地部門密切溝通，為持有香港保單的居民，提供更完善的售後支援，促進兩地保險市場互聯互通。 李家超表示，為保險相連證券設立專屬規管制度，並推出資助計劃，至今已促成7宗巨災債券發行，總額約62億港元，支持內地和環球市場管理風險。他又提到業界亦善用香港作為國際航運中心的優勢，成立獨立的航運專項風險池，為香港和內地船舶提供保障，至今已有超過800艘船隻受保。 他表示，將繼續爭取更多海內外企業在香港成立專屬的自保保險公司，並積極推動業界善用人工智能和保險科技，鼓勵負責任的創新，完善全球市場的風險管理策略。
levels.text_en: Giving a speech at an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents; the government will keep in close communication with mainland departments to provide more comprehensive after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, promoting interconnection of the two places' insurance markets. Lee said that, having set up a dedicated regulatory regime for insurance-linked securities and launched a funding scheme, so far seven catastrophe bonds have been issued, totaling about HK$6.2 billion, supporting risk management in the mainland and global markets. He also mentioned that the sector has made good use of Hong Kong's advantage as an international shipping center by setting up an independent shipping-specific risk pool to provide coverage for Hong Kong and mainland vessels, with over 800 vessels now insured. He said he will continue to attract more domestic and overseas enterprises to set up dedicated captive insurance companies in Hong Kong, and actively push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology, encouraging responsible innovation and improving risk management strategies for the global market.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee spoke at an insurance industry event, encouraging the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products for residents of the Greater Bay Area (the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau region).

articles.title: 社署籲市民避免回覆偽冒社署通訊應用程式帳戶
articles.summary: 社署話有人扮佢哋開咗個假嘅通訊程式帳戶，叫大家唔好回覆，亦唔好畀個人資料。

levels.text: 社署提醒大家小心，有人扮社署開咗個通訊程式帳戶，係假嘅。大家唔好回覆佢，亦唔好畀自己嘅個人資料佢。社署話同呢個帳戶冇任何關係，已經搵警方跟進。大家記住要提高警覺呀。
levels.text_en: The SWD reminds everyone to be careful: someone has opened a messaging-app account pretending to be the SWD—it's fake. Don't reply to it, and don't give it your personal information. The SWD says it has no connection with this account and has already asked the police to follow up. Everyone remember to stay alert.

levels.text: 社會福利署提醒市民要提高警覺，有人扮社署開咗個通訊程式帳戶，其實係假嘅。社署話呢個假帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心，想呃市民回覆佢嘅短訊，或者撳短訊入面嗰啲唔知係咩嘅連結，噉樣就可以盜取市民嘅個人資料。社署強調同呢個帳戶冇任何關係，叫大家唔好回覆，亦唔好向佢提供個人資料，並且已經將件事交畀警方跟進。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department reminds the public to stay alert: someone has opened a messaging-app account pretending to be the SWD, but it's actually fake. The SWD says this fake account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre, trying to trick the public into replying to its messages or clicking unknown links inside the messages, so as to steal people's personal data. The SWD stresses it has no connection with this account, urges everyone not to reply and not to give it personal information, and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up.

levels.text: 社會福利署呼籲市民提高警覺，避免回覆偽冒社署嘅通訊應用程式帳戶，亦唔好向有關帳戶提供個人資料。社署表示，該程式帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心，企圖誘騙市民回覆佢嘅短訊，或者撳短訊入面啲唔明嘅連結，藉此盜取市民嘅個人資料。署方強調，社署同該程式帳戶冇任何關係，並且已經將事件交畀警方跟進。市民如果收到呢類短訊，記住要小心處理，切勿隨便提供自己嘅資料。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department calls on the public to stay alert, to avoid replying to a messaging-app account impersonating the SWD, and not to give that account personal information. The SWD says the account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre, attempting to lure the public into replying to its messages or clicking unclear links inside the messages, thereby stealing people's personal data. The department stresses that the SWD has no connection with the account and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up. If members of the public receive this kind of message, remember to handle it carefully and never carelessly provide your own information.

levels.text: 社會福利署提醒市民提高警覺。近日有偽冒社署嘅通訊程式帳戶出現。市民應避免回覆，亦不要提供個人資料。社署表示，該帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心。它試圖誘騙市民回覆短訊，或撳短訊內不明嘅連結，從而盜取個人資料。社署強調，與該帳戶並無任何關係，並已把事件交警方跟進。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department reminds the public to stay alert. Recently a messaging-app account impersonating the SWD has appeared. The public should avoid replying and should not provide personal information. The SWD says the account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre. It tries to lure the public into replying to messages or clicking unclear links within the messages, so as to steal personal data. The SWD stresses it has no connection with the account and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up.

levels.text: 社會福利署呼籲市民提高警覺，避免回覆偽冒社署的通訊應用程式帳戶，或向有關程式帳戶提供個人資料。 社署表示，該程式帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心，企圖誘騙市民回覆其短訊或點擊短訊內的不明連結，以盗取市民的個人資料。 署方強調與該程式帳戶沒有任何關係，並已把事件交警方跟進。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department calls on the public to stay alert, to avoid replying to a messaging-app account impersonating the SWD, or providing personal information to that account. The SWD says the account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre, attempting to lure the public into replying to its messages or clicking unclear links within the messages, in order to steal people's personal data. The department stresses it has no connection with the account and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up.

articles.summary_en: The Social Welfare Department (SWD) in Hong Kong is warning the public about a fake messaging-app account impersonating the department, which is being used to steal personal data.

articles.title: 選委會界別分組選舉11月22日舉行
articles.summary: 政府話2026年選委會界別分組選舉喺11月22日投票。

levels.text: 政府今日話俾大家知，2026年選委會界別分組選舉會喺11月22日投票，揀出新一屆嘅選委。提名期由10月7日開始，到10月20日就完。之後仲會公布交表嘅時間同地點。
levels.text_en: The government announced today that the 2026 Election Committee subsector election will be held on November 22, to choose the new term of Election Committee members. The nomination period starts on October 7 and ends on October 20. The time and place for submitting forms will be announced later.

levels.text: 政府今日刊憲，公布行政長官已經根據《行政長官選舉條例》嘅規定，指明2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉喺11月22日投票，揀出新一屆選委會嘅選任委員。提名期由10月7日開始，到10月20日結束。總選舉事務主任會喺適當時候刊登公告，指明交提名表格嘅限期同地點，仲會公布相關細節。
levels.text_en: The government published a notice in the gazette today, announcing that the Chief Executive, under the provisions of the Chief Executive Election Ordinance, has specified that the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election will be held on November 22, to choose the elected members of the new-term Election Committee. The nomination period starts on October 7 and ends on October 20. The Chief Electoral Officer will publish a notice at an appropriate time specifying the deadline and location for submitting nomination forms, and will also announce the relevant details.

levels.text: 政府今日刊憲公布，行政長官已經根據《行政長官選舉條例》附表第16條，指明2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉喺11月22日投票，揀出新一屆選委會嘅選任委員。提名期由10月7日開始，到10月20日結束。總選舉事務主任會喺適當時候刊登公告，指明呈交提名表格嘅限期同地點，仲會公布相關細節。
levels.text_en: The government published a gazette notice today, announcing that the Chief Executive, under section 16 of the Schedule to the Chief Executive Election Ordinance, has specified that the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election will be held on November 22, to choose the elected members of the new-term Election Committee. The nomination period starts on October 7 and ends on October 20. The Chief Electoral Officer will publish a notice at an appropriate time specifying the deadline and location for submitting nomination forms, and will also announce the relevant details.

levels.text: 政府今日刊憲公布，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉會在11月22日投票。這次投票會選出新一屆選委會的選任委員。行政長官是根據《行政長官選舉條例》附表第16條作出指明。提名期由10月7日開始，到10月20日結束。總選舉事務主任日後會刊登公告，說明交提名表格的限期和地點，也會公布相關細節。
levels.text_en: The government published a gazette notice today, announcing that the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election will be held on November 22. This vote will choose the elected members of the new-term Election Committee. The Chief Executive made the specification under section 16 of the Schedule to the Chief Executive Election Ordinance. The nomination period starts on October 7 and ends on October 20. The Chief Electoral Officer will later publish a notice explaining the deadline and location for submitting nomination forms, and will also announce the relevant details.

levels.text: 政府今日刊憲公布，行政長官已根據《行政長官選舉條例》附表第16條，指明2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉於11月22日投票，選出新一屆選委會的選任委員。   提名期10月7日開始，10月20日結束。總選舉事務主任會適時刊登公告指明呈交提名表格的限期和地點，以及公布相關細節。
levels.text_en: The government published a gazette notice today, announcing that the Chief Executive, under section 16 of the Schedule to the Chief Executive Election Ordinance, has specified that the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary election will be held on November 22, to choose the elected members of the new-term Election Committee. The nomination period starts on October 7 and ends on October 20. The Chief Electoral Officer will in due course publish a notice specifying the deadline and location for submitting nomination forms, as well as announce the relevant details.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong government announcement about the timing of the 2026 Election Committee subsector elections, which choose members of the Election Committee.

articles.title: 特朗普簽署行政命令　對進口多晶硅徵收關稅
articles.summary: 美國總統特朗普簽咗命令，要對外國入口嘅多晶硅收關稅，中國就話好反對。

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽咗一份命令，要對外國運入嚟嘅多晶硅收關稅。多晶硅係用嚟做電腦晶片同太陽能板嘅，佢想美國少啲靠外國供應。稅率大約一成半，一百二十日之後先生效。中國就話好反對美國噉樣做。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an order to charge tariffs on polysilicon imported from abroad. Polysilicon is used to make computer chips and solar panels, and he wants the US to rely less on foreign supply. The tariff rate is about 15%, and it takes effect only after 120 days. China said it strongly opposes the US doing this.

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽咗一份行政命令，要對外國運入嚟嘅多晶硅收關稅。多晶硅係用嚟整半導體同太陽能板嘅，特朗普想美國少啲靠外國供應。白宮嘅顧問沙夫話，稅率預計係一成半，仲會有最低價格限制，措施一百二十日之後先生效。喺北京嗰邊，外交部發言人林劍就話，中方堅決反對美方噉樣無理打壓中國企業，會繼續維護中國企業嘅正當權益。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an executive order to charge tariffs on polysilicon imported from abroad. Polysilicon is used to make semiconductors and solar panels, and Trump wants the US to rely less on foreign supply. White House adviser Shaw said the tariff rate is expected to be 15%, and there will also be a minimum price limit; the measure takes effect only after 120 days. In Beijing, foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian said China firmly opposes the US unreasonably suppressing Chinese enterprises like this, and will continue to protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽署咗一份行政命令，對用嚟做半導體同太陽能電池板嘅進口多晶硅徵收關稅，希望減少對外國供應嘅依賴。白宮顧問沙夫話，特朗普喺當地星期四簽署呢份命令，根據《貿易擴展法》第232條，採取一系列貿易同關稅行動，確保美國國內嘅多晶硅製造業得到保護，免受海外傾銷同競爭威脅。有消息話進口多晶硅稅率預計係15%，並且會有最低價格限制，措施120日之後生效。喺北京，外交部發言人林劍回應時話，中方堅決反對美方濫用國家力量無理打壓中國企業，會繼續維護中國企業嘅正當合法權益。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an executive order imposing tariffs on imported polysilicon used to make semiconductors and solar panels, hoping to reduce reliance on foreign supply. White House adviser Shaw said Trump signed the order on local Thursday, and under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act, took a series of trade and tariff actions to ensure the US domestic polysilicon manufacturing industry is protected from overseas dumping and competitive threats. Sources say the tariff rate on imported polysilicon is expected to be 15%, and there will be a minimum price limit; the measure takes effect after 120 days. In Beijing, foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian responded that China firmly opposes the US abusing state power to unreasonably suppress Chinese enterprises, and will continue to protect the legitimate and lawful rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽署了一份行政命令，對進口的多晶硅徵收關稅。多晶硅是用來製造半導體和太陽能電池板的材料。特朗普希望減少對外國供應的依賴。白宮顧問沙夫表示，這是根據《貿易擴展法》採取的行動，用來保護美國本地的製造業。消息指，進口多晶硅的稅率大約是15%，並設有最低價格，措施在120天後生效。中國外交部發言人林劍回應說，中方堅決反對美方無理打壓中國企業，會繼續維護中國企業的合法權益。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an executive order imposing tariffs on imported polysilicon. Polysilicon is a material used to make semiconductors and solar panels. Trump hopes to reduce reliance on foreign supply. White House adviser Shaw stated that this is an action taken under the Trade Expansion Act, used to protect US local manufacturing. Reports indicate the tariff rate on imported polysilicon is about 15%, with a minimum price set, and the measure takes effect after 120 days. China's foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian responded that China firmly opposes the US unreasonably suppressing Chinese enterprises, and will continue to protect the lawful rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽署行政命令，對用於半導體和太陽能電池板的進口多晶硅徵收關稅，期望減少對外國供應的依賴。 路透社報道，白宮顧問沙夫表示，特朗普當地星期四簽署行政命令，根據《貿易擴展法》第232條款，採取一系列貿易和關稅行動，確保美國國內多晶硅製造業，得到適當的支援和保護，免受海外傾銷及競爭威脅。 路透社引述消息人士表示，進口多晶硅的稅率預計為15%，並將有最低價格限制；措施120天後生效。 在北京，外交部發言人林劍前日回應有關提問時表示，中方堅決反對美方泛化國家安全概念，濫用國家力量無理打壓中國企業，美方做法嚴重阻礙中美企業正常經貿往來，不符合美國企業及消費者在內的各方利益，中方將繼續堅定維護中國企業的正當合法權益。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an executive order imposing tariffs on imported polysilicon used for semiconductors and solar panels, hoping to reduce reliance on foreign supply. Reuters reported that White House adviser Shaw stated Trump signed the executive order on local Thursday, and under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act, took a series of trade and tariff actions to ensure the US domestic polysilicon manufacturing industry receives appropriate support and protection from overseas dumping and competitive threats. Reuters cited sources saying the tariff rate on imported polysilicon is expected to be 15%, and there will be a minimum price limit; the measure takes effect after 120 days. In Beijing, foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian, responding to related questions the day before yesterday, said China firmly opposes the US generalizing the concept of national security and abusing state power to unreasonably suppress Chinese enterprises; the US approach seriously hinders normal trade and economic exchanges between Chinese and US enterprises, and does not conform to the interests of all parties including US enterprises and consumers, and China will continue to firmly protect the legitimate and lawful rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

articles.summary_en: US President Trump signed an executive order imposing tariffs on imported polysilicon, a material used to make semiconductors/computer chips and solar panels, aiming to reduce reliance on foreign supply. China's foreign ministry objected.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】房屋局當然違反《公開資料守則》
articles.summary: 房屋局唔肯公開宏福苑驗樓報告，作者話佢其實違反咗《公開資料守則》。

levels.text: 火災之後，宏福苑啲居民好想睇驗樓報告，但係房屋局唔肯公開。房屋局話報告未做完，怕大家睇錯，所以唔畀報告出街。有記者向政府投訴，但係申訴署話房屋局冇做錯。作者就好唔同意，佢覺得房屋局係搵藉口，其實可以公開報告，只要加返啲解釋就得㗎喇。
levels.text_en: After the fire, residents of Wang Fuk Court really wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau refused to make it public. The Bureau said the report wasn't finished and worried people would misread it, so it wouldn't release it. A reporter complained to the government, but the Ombudsman said the Housing Bureau did nothing wrong. The author strongly disagrees. He thinks the Housing Bureau is making excuses—it actually could release the report, as long as it added some explanatory notes.

levels.text: 宏福苑火災之後，好多居民都想睇驗樓報告，但係房屋局一直唔肯公開。《明報》記者根據《公開資料守則》向房屋局要報告，等咗成個幾月，房屋局先話：因為就到雨季風季、樓宇結構要繼續監測、報告未做完可能令人誤解，所以拒絕公開。記者於是向申訴專員公署投訴，話收購宏福苑用咗公帑，關乎公眾利益。點知申訴署都話房屋局冇違反《守則》。作者好懷疑：房屋局究竟用邊條《守則》去封鎖報告呢？其實《守則》話明，就算資料未完成，只要加返啲解釋，部門一樣可以公開。所以房屋局根本係搵藉口。
levels.text_en: After the fire at Wang Fuk Court, many residents wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau kept refusing to make it public. A Ming Pao reporter requested the report from the Housing Bureau under the Code on Access to Information. After waiting more than a month, the Bureau finally said: because the rainy and typhoon season was coming, the building structure needed continued monitoring, and an unfinished report could mislead people, it refused to release it. The reporter then complained to the Office of the Ombudsman, saying the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court used public funds and concerned the public interest. But the Ombudsman also said the Housing Bureau did not violate the Code. The author is very skeptical: which clause of the Code exactly did the Housing Bureau use to lock up the report? In fact, the Code clearly states that even if information is unfinished, a department can still release it as long as it adds explanatory notes. So the Housing Bureau is simply making excuses.

levels.text: 宏福苑火災之後，居民都好想睇驗樓報告，但係房屋局一直拒絕公開。《明報》記者早喺五月初就根據《公開資料守則》向房屋局索取報告，等到六月底，房屋局先話：因為將有雨季風季、樓宇結構要持續監測，加上報告未完成可能令人誤解，所以唔公開。記者馬上要求覆檢，又向申訴專員公署投訴，指收購宏福苑涉及公帑同公眾利益。但申訴署喺八月回覆話，未見表面證據顯示房屋局違反《守則》，唔會再跟進。作者質疑：房屋局究竟引用邊條《守則》呢？原來《守則》2.13(a)話，如果披露未完成嘅分析可能令人誤解，部門「可」拒絕。但同一份指引又講明，只要「附上註釋解釋資料嘅不足」，部門依然可以公開。所以房屋局其實係斷章取義。而家房屋局推緊一項重大政策，直接影響近二千戶居民嘅去留，理應同步畀足夠資料居民，唔應該用「報告未完成」做藉口全部保密。
levels.text_en: After the fire at Wang Fuk Court, residents wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau kept refusing to make it public. A Ming Pao reporter, back in early May, requested the report from the Housing Bureau under the Code on Access to Information. It wasn't until late June that the Bureau said: because the rainy and typhoon season was coming, the building structure needed ongoing monitoring, and an unfinished report could mislead people, it would not release it. The reporter immediately requested a review and also complained to the Office of the Ombudsman, pointing out that the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court involved public funds and the public interest. But in August the Ombudsman replied that there was no prima facie evidence the Housing Bureau violated the Code, and it would not follow up further. The author questions: which clause of the Code exactly did the Housing Bureau cite? It turns out Code section 2.13(a) says that if disclosing an unfinished analysis could mislead people, a department 'may' refuse. But the same guidance also states that as long as it 'attaches notes explaining the shortcomings of the information,' the department can still release it. So the Housing Bureau is actually quoting out of context. Right now the Housing Bureau is pushing a major policy that directly affects the future of nearly two thousand households; it should be providing residents with sufficient information at the same time, and should not use 'the report isn't finished' as an excuse to keep everything secret.

levels.text: 宏福苑火災之後，居民想看驗樓報告，但房屋局一直不肯公開。《明報》記者五月初依據《公開資料守則》向房屋局索取報告。等到六月底，房屋局才拒絕。理由是快到雨季風季、樓宇結構要繼續監測，加上報告未完成，公開會令人誤解。記者要求重新審視，又向申訴專員公署投訴，指出收購宏福苑用了公帑，關乎公眾利益。八月，申訴署回覆，說看不到房屋局違反《守則》，不會再跟進。但作者不同意。《守則》2.13(a)只是說部門「可以」不公開，並非必須不公開。同一份指引又寫明：只要加上說明，解釋資料哪裡不足，部門仍可以發放。所以房屋局把2.13(a)當擋箭牌，其實是斷章取義。現在房屋局正推動一項重大政策，直接影響近二千戶居民。按指引精神，局方應同步提供足夠資料，不應以報告未完成為理由全部保密。
levels.text_en: After the fire at Wang Fuk Court, residents wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau kept refusing to make it public. In early May a Ming Pao reporter requested the report from the Housing Bureau under the Code on Access to Information. It wasn't until late June that the Bureau refused. The reasons were that the rainy and typhoon season was approaching, the building structure needed continued monitoring, and, with the report unfinished, releasing it would mislead people. The reporter requested a re-examination and also complained to the Office of the Ombudsman, pointing out that the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court used public funds and concerned the public interest. In August the Ombudsman replied that it saw no violation of the Code by the Housing Bureau and would not follow up further. But the author disagrees. Code section 2.13(a) only says a department 'may' withhold—not that it must. The same guidance also states clearly: as long as an explanation is added noting where the information falls short, the department can still release it. So the Housing Bureau using 2.13(a) as a shield is actually quoting out of context. The Housing Bureau is now promoting a major policy that directly affects nearly two thousand households. According to the spirit of the guidance, the Bureau should provide sufficient information at the same time, and should not keep everything secret on the grounds that the report is unfinished.

levels.text: 昨日《明報》有篇報道，題為「申訴署認可房局不披露宏福驗樓報告 稱未違公開資料守則 居民：延公開為引導售業權」，我閱後只想到一個四字成語，也見於今天《東方日報》的標題「房屋局拒披露驗樓報告 災民：似官官相衞」，真是人同此心，心同此理。 《明報》在5月初曾援引《公開資料守則》（下稱《守則》），向房屋局索取宏福苑災後驗樓報告。一直等到6月底——港府真有「效率」——房屋局終以「將有雨季風季、樓宇結構安全需持續監測、披露未完成分析資料或令人誤解」為由，拒絕公開報告。記者馬上向房屋局提出覆檢、向申訴專員公署申訴，並列出多項理由，包括宏福苑收購涉公帑及公眾利益等。 7月7日房屋局回覆《明報》，堅拒披露報告。申訴專員公署在8月4日亦回覆稱，不會進一步處理申訴，理由是房屋局已援引《守則》解釋拒絕理由，未見表面證據顯示房屋局違反《守則》。我不禁好奇，房屋局到底引用了哪條《守則》去支持「封鎖報告」的決定呢？ 原來《守則》第2部定義了哪類資料可拒絕公開——留意用字是「可」，不是「須」，就算某些資料符合拒絕公布的定義，部門依然有權決定把它公開——其中2.13(a)說，「如披露與不完整或未完成的分析、研究或統計有關資料，可能會令人產生誤解」，部門可決定不披露。這就是房屋局所援引的《守則》條文。 然而關於2.13(a)的真正意思，《守則》詮釋及應用指引第2.13.2條有以下澄清：「《守則》第 2.13(a)段的條文認同，如與不完整或未完成的分析、研究或統計有關的資料會造成誤解，部門可不予披露。不過，如附上註釋解釋資料的不足之處，部門或可決定發放這類資料。」 換言之，指引本身早已預見資料不完整的情況，並提供了解決方法：若不完整的資料可能造成誤解，部門依然「可決定發放這類資料」，但須「附上註釋解釋資料的不足之處」。因此，即使宏福苑樓宇結構真的需要持續監測、評估真的尚未完成，亦不妨礙房屋局公布現有的驗樓結果，只需「附上註釋」就行。 由此可見，房屋局搬出《守則》2.13(a)作擋箭牌，根本是斷章取義。其實《守則》詮釋及應用指引第2.13.1條也寫得很清楚：分析、研究資料及統計數字，理應與其他資料一視同仁地披露；政府宣布政策決定時，亦應公布相關性質的具體資料，以協助公眾理解決定的內容與依據。 房屋局現正推動的，正正是一項重大政策決定：以「接受收購建議信件」方式處理宏福苑業權，直接影響近二千戶居民的產權和去留。既然政策已經啟動，按照指引精神，局方理應同步向居民提供充足資料，作為他們做決定的分析基礎，而非以「報告未完成」為由一概保密。 至於申訴專員公署以「未見表面證據顯示房屋局違反《守則》」為由拒絕跟進，這個結論本身也很值得商榷。公署審視的，似乎只是房屋局有沒有「援引」《守則》並「交代」理由，但這只是門面功夫，根本沒有實質審查房屋局提出的理由是否成立、是否符合《守則》原意。《守則》原意是什麼，不是由申
levels.text_en: Yesterday Ming Pao ran a report headlined 'Ombudsman endorses Housing Bureau's non-disclosure of Wang Fuk inspection report, saying it did not breach the Code on Access to Information; residents: delaying disclosure is to steer the sale of ownership.' After reading it, only one four-character idiom came to mind—one also seen in today's Oriental Daily headline 'Housing Bureau refuses to disclose inspection report; disaster victims: looks like officials shielding officials.' Truly, everyone feels the same way. In early May Ming Pao invoked the Code on Access to Information (hereafter 'the Code') to request from the Housing Bureau the post-disaster building inspection report for Wang Fuk Court. It waited all the way until late June—the Hong Kong government really is 'efficient'—before the Housing Bureau finally refused to release the report, citing that the rainy and typhoon season was coming, the building's structural safety needed ongoing monitoring, and disclosing incomplete analysis could mislead people. The reporter immediately requested a review from the Housing Bureau and lodged a complaint with the Office of the Ombudsman, listing several reasons, including that the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court involved public funds and the public interest. On 7 July the Housing Bureau replied to Ming Pao, firmly refusing to disclose the report. On 4 August the Office of the Ombudsman also replied, saying it would not take the complaint further, because the Housing Bureau had already cited the Code to explain its refusal and there was no prima facie evidence it had breached the Code. I can't help but wonder: which clause of the Code exactly did the Housing Bureau invoke to support its decision to 'lock up the report'? It turns out Part 2 of the Code defines which categories of information may be refused—note the word is 'may,' not 'must'; even if certain information meets the definition for refusing disclosure, a department still has the power to decide to release it. Among these, 2.13(a) says that if disclosing information relating to incomplete or unfinished analysis, research or statistics 'could be misleading,' a department may decide not to disclose. This is the Code clause the Housing Bureau invoked. However, regarding the true meaning of 2.13(a), section 2.13.2 of the Code's Interpretation and Application Guidelines clarifies: 'The provision in Code paragraph 2.13(a) recognizes that if information relating to incomplete or unfinished analysis, research or statistics would be misleading, a department may withhold it. However, if a note is attached explaining the shortcomings of the information, the department may decide to release such information.' In other words, the guidance itself long ago anticipated the situation of incomplete information and provided a solution: if incomplete information could be misleading, the department can still 'decide to release such information,' but must 'attach a note explaining the shortcomings of the information.' Therefore, even if Wang Fuk Court's building structure really does need continued monitoring and the assessment really is not yet complete, this does not prevent the Housing Bureau from publishing the existing inspection results—it just needs to 'attach a note.' This shows that the Housing Bureau trotting out Code 2.13(a) as a shield is basically quoting out of context. In fact, section 2.13.1 of the Code's Interpretation and Application Guidelines also states clearly: analysis, research information and statistics should be disclosed on the same footing as other information; when the government announces a policy decision, it should also publish specific information of the relevant nature to help the public understand the content and basis of the decision. What the Housing Bureau is now promoting is precisely a major policy decision: handling Wang Fuk Court's ownership by way of 'accepting the acquisition offer letter,' directly affecting the property rights and futures of nearly two thousand households. Since the policy has already been launched, then by the spirit of the guidance, the Bureau should be providing residents with sufficient information at the same time, as an analytical basis for their decisions, rather than withholding everything on the grounds that 'the report is unfinished.' As for the Office of the Ombudsman refusing to follow up on the grounds that 'there is no prima facie evidence the Housing Bureau breached the Code,' this conclusion itself is highly questionable. What the Office reviewed seems to be merely whether the Housing Bureau 'invoked' the Code and 'gave' reasons—but this is only surface work, with no substantive examination of whether the Housing Bureau's stated reasons actually hold up or conform to the intent of the Code. As for what the Code's intent is, it is not for the [Ombudsman to decide]...

articles.summary_en: After a fire at Wang Fuk Court (a housing estate), residents want to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau refuses to release it. A Ming Pao reporter requested it under the Code on Access to Information; the Ombudsman sided with the Housing Bureau. The author argues the Bureau is misusing the Code as an excuse.

articles.title: 6外傭被控違逗留條件等　4人先後表證不成立　官：入境處接近恣意拘捕、非法羈留
articles.summary: 6個外傭被告喺牙醫診所非法工作嘅案，法官話入境處拘捕手法有問題，判其中兩人表證不成立當庭放走。

levels.text: 有6個外傭被人告話喺深水埗一個單位無牌做牙醫，仲違反逗留條件。當中兩人認咗罪，另外四人有兩人早前已經放走。周五法官話，入境處喺現場錄嘅口供唔可以用，控方又冇其他證據，所以判兩人表證不成立，當庭放人。兩人聽到判決好激動，一個仲用紙巾抹眼淚。
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of practising dentistry without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, and of breaching their stay conditions. Two of them pleaded guilty; of the other four, two had already been released earlier. On Friday the judge said the confessions recorded by Immigration at the scene could not be used, and the prosecution had no other evidence, so he ruled there was no case to answer for the two and released them in court. The two were very emotional on hearing the verdict, one wiping away tears with a tissue.

levels.text: 6個外傭被人指喺深水埗一個單位無牌經營牙醫診所，仲違反逗留條件。兩人認咗罪，另外兩人早前已經放走，餘下兩人繼續受審。周五法官彭亮廷話，入境處人員喺拘捕現場為兩人錄嘅招認口供唔可以呈堂，加上控方冇其他證據，所以判兩人表證不成立，當庭釋放。兩人聽判時好激動，其中一人掩住面抹眼淚。法官話，入境處人員冇搜查令、冇合理懷疑就入單位，「接近構成恣意拘捕」，仲喺解釋權利之前就錄口供，好似想快啲攞到招認。辯方申請訟費，法官押後裁決。入境處話尊重裁決，會仔細研究法庭意見。
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of operating a dental clinic without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, and of breaching their stay conditions. Two pleaded guilty, two others had already been released earlier, and the remaining two continued to stand trial. On Friday Magistrate Pang Leung-ting said the confession statements recorded by immigration officers for the two at the arrest scene could not be admitted, and since the prosecution had no other evidence, he ruled there was no case to answer and released them in court. The two were very emotional on hearing the verdict, one covering her face and wiping tears. The judge said immigration officers entered the flat without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion, which "came close to arbitrary arrest", and recorded statements before explaining their rights, as if wanting to quickly obtain confessions. The defence applied for costs; the judge reserved his ruling. Immigration said it respected the ruling and would study the court's views carefully.

levels.text: 6名外傭被指喺深水埗一個單位無牌經營牙醫診所，又違反逗留條件。兩人認罪，另外兩人早前已獲判表證不成立，餘下兩人繼續受審。裁判官彭亮廷周五裁定，入境處人員喺拘捕現場為兩人錄取嘅招認口供唔可以呈堂；因為控方冇其他證據，所以判兩人表證不成立，當庭釋放。兩人聽判時神情激動，其中一人掩面抹淚。法官指，入境處人員冇搜查令、冇合理懷疑就進入單位，「接近構成恣意拘捕」，更喺解釋權利之前就錄口供，「唔能夠排除」係想盡快攞到招認，而且現場人員職級亦無權羈留。官亦質疑各人都能講出細節，令人懷疑上庭前曾討論案情。辯方申請訟費，官押後裁決。入境處話尊重裁決，會仔細研究法庭意見，完善工作流程，確保執法公正。
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of operating a dental clinic without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, and of breaching their stay conditions. Two pleaded guilty, two others had earlier been found to have no case to answer, and the remaining two continued to stand trial. On Friday Magistrate Pang Leung-ting ruled that the confession statements recorded by immigration officers for the two at the arrest scene could not be admitted; because the prosecution had no other evidence, he ruled there was no case to answer and released them in court. The two looked emotional on hearing the verdict, one covering her face and wiping tears. The judge said immigration officers entered the flat without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion, which "came close to arbitrary arrest", and moreover recorded statements before explaining their rights, so it "could not be ruled out" they wanted to obtain confessions as quickly as possible; the officers present were also not of a rank with power to detain. The judge also questioned that everyone could give details, raising suspicion that the case had been discussed before going to court. The defence applied for costs; the judge reserved his ruling. Immigration said it respected the ruling and would study the court's views carefully, improve its work procedures, and ensure fair law enforcement.

levels.text: 6名外傭被指喺深水埗一個單位無牌經營牙醫診所，並違反逗留條件。其中兩人認罪，另外兩人早前已獲判表證不成立，餘下兩人繼續受審。裁判官彭亮廷周五裁定，入境處人員在現場為兩人錄取的招認口供不可呈堂。由於控方沒有其他證據，法官判兩人表證不成立，當庭釋放。兩人聽判時十分激動，其中一人用紙巾抹淚。法官指出，入境處人員無搜查令，也無合理懷疑就進入單位，做法接近恣意拘捕；更在解釋權利前錄口供，似乎想盡快取得招認，而在場人員職級亦無權羈留。辯方申請訟費，法官押後裁決。入境處回應稱尊重裁決，會研究法庭意見，完善工作流程,確保執法公正。
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of operating a dental clinic without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, and of breaching their stay conditions. Two of them pleaded guilty, two others had earlier been found to have no case to answer, and the remaining two continued to stand trial. On Friday Magistrate Pang Leung-ting ruled that the confession statements recorded by immigration officers at the scene for the two could not be admitted. Since the prosecution had no other evidence, the judge ruled there was no case to answer and released them in court. The two were very emotional on hearing the verdict, one wiping tears with a tissue. The judge pointed out that immigration officers entered the flat without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion, an approach that came close to arbitrary arrest; and recorded statements before explaining rights, seemingly wanting to obtain confessions as quickly as possible, while the officers present were not of a rank with power to detain. The defence applied for costs; the judge reserved his ruling. Immigration responded that it respected the ruling and would study the court's views, improve its work procedures, and ensure fair law enforcement.

levels.text: 6 名外傭被指於深水埗一單位無牌經營牙醫診所、違逗留條件等，兩人認罪，兩人日前獲裁表證不成立，餘下兩人繼續受審。裁判官彭亮廷周五（7 日）裁定，入境處人員在拘捕現場為兩人錄取的招認口供不能呈堂，基於控方沒有其他證據，遂裁定控罪表證不成立，兩被告當庭釋放。兩人聞判時神情激動，其中一人掩面拭淚。 官指，入境處人員無搜查令、無合理懷疑進入單位，「接近構成恣意拘捕」，更在解釋權利前向被捕人錄口供，「不能排除」是想盡快取得招認，且現場人員職級亦無權羈留。官亦質疑人員均能供述細節，令人質疑上庭前曾討論案情。辯方申請訟費，官押後裁決。 入境處指，尊重法庭的裁決，並將仔細研究法庭的意見，處方會完善工作流程細節，確保執行職務時的公正性，並繼續不遺餘力打擊違法行為。 Day7｜辯方質疑入境處一度非法拘留、威嚇招認 入境處：尊重裁決仔細研究 入境處回覆《法庭線》指，尊重法庭的裁決，並將仔細研究法庭的意見。處方會完善每一個工作流程細節，確保執行職務時的公正性，並繼續不遺餘力，打擊違法行為，維持社會治安。 官裁定招認供詞不能呈堂 辯方指控方餘下證據接近零 裁判官彭亮廷周五首先就特別事項，即入境處人員在記事冊中記錄兩名被告的口頭招認供詞，以及「被羈留人士通知書」能否呈堂作出裁決，指在考慮雙方陳詞後，認為控方未能就兩項證供的表面證供舉證至毫無合理疑點，裁定特別事項表證不成立，即法庭不接納兩被告的口頭招認供詞及「被羈留人士通知書」呈堂。 主控、律政司外聘大律師施善政（Sakhrani Sanjay）表示，控方就本案沒有其他證據。辯方大律師麥晶晶（Yasmine Zahir）隨即作出中段陳詞，指本案缺乏表證，被告應毋須答辯。 辯方陳詞指，控方案情的核心在於兩名被告的口頭招認，在法庭拒納口頭招認及「被羈留人士通知書」後，「控方案情所剩下的證供極有限，若不是『零』」。 辯方指出，入境處人員非法進入涉案單位，沒有搜查令、沒有合理懷疑單位內的人干犯甚麼罪行，並作出了非法羈留；控方證物包括一張草圖，標示各被告在單位內被截停的位置，惟入境事務助理梁倩童（音譯）在庭上確認，該草圖是事後繪製。 換言之，案中無證據顯示被告在何處被裁停，入境處人員亦看不到被告在做甚麼事，她們只是坐在單位內，亦無證據顯示相關牙科用具在單位內的甚麼位置、無證據顯示被告曾觸碰任何用具。 辯方總結，本案無證據顯示被告犯下相關罪行，而即使有證據亦是站不住腳，懇請法庭終結本案，裁定表證不成立。 控方沒有陳詞。官即時裁定，基於法庭不接納記事冊上的招認供詞呈堂，本案已沒有進一步證據針對第二及第四被告，因此必須裁定表證不成立，毋須答辯，並正式裁定兩人所有罪名不成立。兩人聞判神情激動，散庭時，她們與法律團隊相擁，第四被告以紙巾拭淚。 法律101｜何謂「表證成立」？裁定表證是否成立之前，法庭在考慮甚麼？ 官：入境處人員「接近恣意拘捕」 裁判官其後讀
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of operating a dental clinic without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, breaching their stay conditions and so on; two pleaded guilty, two were found earlier to have no case to answer, and the remaining two continued to stand trial. On Friday (the 7th) Magistrate Pang Leung-ting ruled that the confession statements recorded by immigration officers for the two at the arrest scene could not be admitted, and since the prosecution had no other evidence, he ruled there was no case to answer on the charges and the two defendants were released in court. The two looked emotional on hearing the verdict, one covering her face and wiping tears. The judge said immigration officers entered the flat without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion, which "came close to arbitrary arrest", and moreover recorded statements from the arrested before explaining their rights, so it "could not be ruled out" they wanted to obtain confessions as quickly as possible; the officers present were also not of a rank with power to detain. The judge also questioned that the officers could all give details, raising suspicion that the case had been discussed before going to court. The defence applied for costs; the judge reserved his ruling. Immigration said it respected the court's ruling and would study the court's views carefully, improve its work procedures, and ensure fair law enforcement. Day 7 | Defence questions Immigration's once-unlawful detention and coerced confessions; Immigration: respects ruling, will study carefully. Immigration told Witness Hong Kong (The Witness) it respected the court's ruling and would study the court's views carefully. The department will refine every detail of its work procedures to ensure fairness in carrying out its duties, and will continue to spare no effort in combating unlawful acts and maintaining public order. Judge rules confession statements inadmissible; defence says prosecution's remaining evidence close to zero. Magistrate Pang Leung-ting first ruled on the special issues, namely whether the two defendants' oral confession statements recorded in the notebooks, and the "Notice to Person Detained", could be admitted, saying that after considering both sides' submissions, he found the prosecution had failed to prove a prima facie case for the two pieces of evidence beyond reasonable doubt, so there was no case to answer on the special issues, meaning the court would not admit the two defendants' oral confession statements and the "Notice to Person Detained". The lead prosecutor, barrister Sakhrani Sanjay externally engaged by the Department of Justice, said the prosecution had no other evidence in this case. Defence barrister Yasmine Zahir then made a submission of no case to answer, saying the case lacked a prima facie case and the defendants need not answer. The defence submitted that the core of the prosecution case was the two defendants' oral confessions, and after the court refused to admit the oral confessions and the "Notice to Person Detained", "the evidence remaining in the prosecution case is extremely limited, if not 'zero'". The defence pointed out that immigration officers unlawfully entered the flat, without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion that anyone in the flat had committed any offence, and carried out unlawful detention; the prosecution exhibits included a sketch marking where each defendant was stopped in the flat, but immigration assistant Leung Sin-tung (transliterated) confirmed in court that the sketch was drawn afterwards. In other words, there was no evidence showing where the defendants were stopped, and immigration officers did not see what the defendants were doing; they were just sitting in the flat, and there was no evidence showing where the dental instruments were in the flat, nor any evidence that the defendants had touched any instruments. The defence concluded that there was no evidence showing the defendants had committed the offences, and even if there were it would not stand, and pleaded with the court to end the case and rule no case to answer. The prosecution made no submission. The judge immediately ruled that, since the court would not admit the confession statements in the notebooks, there was no further evidence against the second and fourth defendants, so he had to rule no case to answer, they need not answer, and formally found the two not guilty on all charges. The two were emotional on hearing the verdict; when the court rose, they embraced their legal team, and the fourth defendant wiped tears with a tissue. Law 101 | What is a "prima facie case"? What does the court consider before deciding whether a prima facie case is established? Judge: immigration officers "came close to arbitrary arrest". The magistrate then read...

articles.summary_en: A Hong Kong court case: six foreign domestic helpers were accused of unlicensed dental practice at a flat in Sham Shui Po and of breaching their stay conditions. Magistrate Pang Leung-ting ruled on the remaining two defendants, criticising the Immigration Department's conduct.

articles.title: 天文台預料未來數日天氣持續酷熱
articles.summary: 天文台話未來幾日都會好熱，叫大家小心中暑。

levels.text: 天文台話，有個熱帶氣旋叫鯨魚，今日會經過呂宋，慢慢會弱返落嚟，對香港冇乜大威脅。今明兩日香港啲風好細。之後就會受另一個叫白海豚嘅熱帶氣旋影響，預料未來幾日都會好熱。天文台叫大家小心自己身體，唔好中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says there's a tropical cyclone called Whale that will pass over Luzon today and slowly weaken; it's no big threat to Hong Kong. The wind in Hong Kong will be light today and tomorrow. After that, Hong Kong will be affected by another tropical cyclone called White Dolphin, and it's expected to be very hot for the next few days. The Observatory tells everyone to take care of their bodies and not get heatstroke.

levels.text: 天文台話，有個熱帶氣旋叫鯨魚，會喺今日橫過呂宋，之後慢慢減弱，對本港嘅直接威脅唔大。本港今明兩日啲風都好微弱。跟住會受另一個熱帶氣旋白海豚嘅外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台預料未來幾日天氣都會持續好熱。天文台提醒市民留意自己嘅身體狀況，小心唔好中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says there's a tropical cyclone called Whale that will cross Luzon today and then slowly weaken; its direct threat to Hong Kong is not big. The wind in Hong Kong will be very weak today and tomorrow. After that Hong Kong will be affected by the outer subsiding airflow of another tropical cyclone, White Dolphin. The Observatory expects the weather will stay very hot for the next few days. The Observatory reminds citizens to pay attention to their physical condition and be careful not to get heatstroke.

levels.text: 天文台表示，熱帶氣旋鯨魚會喺今日橫過呂宋，並且逐漸減弱，對本港嘅直接威脅唔大。本港今明兩日風勢都好微弱。隨後就會受到另一個熱帶氣旋白海豚嘅外圍下沉氣流影響，天文台預料未來數日天氣會持續酷熱。天文台提醒市民留意自己嘅身體狀況，慎防中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory states that tropical cyclone Whale will cross Luzon today and gradually weaken; its direct threat to Hong Kong is not big. The wind in Hong Kong will be very weak today and tomorrow. Subsequently it will be affected by the outer subsiding airflow of another tropical cyclone, White Dolphin. The Observatory expects the weather will remain scorching hot for the next few days. The Observatory reminds citizens to pay attention to their physical condition and guard against heatstroke.

levels.text: 天文台表示，熱帶氣旋鯨魚今日會橫過呂宋，並會逐漸減弱。它對本港的直接威脅不大。本港今明兩日風勢微弱。之後會受另一個熱帶氣旋白海豚的外圍下沉氣流影響。天文台預料未來數日天氣持續酷熱。天文台提醒市民留意身體狀況，小心中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory states that tropical cyclone Whale will cross Luzon today and will gradually weaken. Its direct threat to Hong Kong is not big. The wind in Hong Kong will be weak today and tomorrow. After that it will be affected by the outer subsiding airflow of another tropical cyclone, White Dolphin. The Observatory expects the weather will remain scorching hot for the next few days. The Observatory reminds citizens to pay attention to their physical condition and be careful of heatstroke.

levels.text: 天文台表示，熱帶氣旋鯨魚會在今日橫過呂宋並逐漸減弱，對本港直接威脅不大，本港今明兩日風勢微弱，隨後受熱帶氣旋白海豚的外圍下沉氣流影響，預料未來數日天氣持續酷熱，天文台提醒市民留意身體狀況，慎防中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory states that tropical cyclone Whale will cross Luzon today and gradually weaken, posing little direct threat to Hong Kong; the wind in Hong Kong will be weak today and tomorrow, then it will be affected by the outer subsiding airflow of tropical cyclone White Dolphin, and the weather is expected to remain scorching hot for the next few days. The Observatory reminds citizens to pay attention to their physical condition and guard against heatstroke.

articles.summary_en: The Hong Kong Observatory issues a weather forecast about tropical cyclones and hot weather. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. "Whale" (鯨魚) and "White Dolphin" (白海豚) are the names of two tropical cyclones.

articles.title: 新一批銀債推出 保證息率4.25厘
articles.summary: 政府出新一批銀色債券，畀1967年或之前出世嘅香港人買，保證息率唔少過4.25厘。

levels.text: 政府又出咗新一批銀色債券，畀1967年或者之前出世嘅香港人買。呢批銀債期限三年，每手一萬蚊，保證息率唔少過4.25厘，每六個月派一次息。想買嘅人可以喺本月21日到下月4日認購。政府話咁樣可以畀長者一個安全又穩定嘅選擇。
levels.text_en: The government has issued another new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong people born in 1967 or earlier to buy. This batch of Silver Bonds has a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, and interest is paid once every six months. People who want to buy can subscribe from the 21st of this month to the 4th of next month. The government says this gives the elderly a safe and stable option.

levels.text: 政府推出新一批銀色債券，畀1967年或者之前出世嘅香港居民認購。銀債期限三年，每手一萬蚊，保證息率唔少過4.25厘，每六個月派息一次，息率同本地通脹掛鉤。認購期由本月21日上午9時，到下月4日下午2時。每位投資者最多可以買100手，即係100萬蚊。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇話，今次募集到嘅錢會撥入基本工程儲備基金。銀債下月15日正式發行。
levels.text_en: The government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong residents born in 1967 or earlier to subscribe. The Silver Bonds have a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, interest is paid once every six months, and the rate is linked to local inflation. The subscription period runs from 9am on the 21st of this month to 2pm on the 4th of next month. Each investor can buy at most 100 lots, that is HK$1 million. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the funds raised this time will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund. The Silver Bonds will be formally issued on the 15th of next month.

levels.text: 政府推出新一批銀色債券，供1967年或之前出世嘅香港居民認購。銀債年期三年，每手一萬元，保證息率不少於4.25厘，每六個月派息一次，息率同本地通脹掛鉤。認購期為本月21日上午9時至下月4日下午2時。呢批銀債喺基礎建設債券計劃下發行，目標發行額500億元，如果認購反應好，最多可以加到550億元。每名投資者最多可獲配發100手，即100萬元。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇話，募集到嘅資金會撥入基本工程儲備基金。財政司司長陳茂波話，發行銀債係想為長者提供安全、穩定、低風險嘅投資選擇。銀債下月15日發行，合資格人士可以透過配售銀行同指定證券經紀認購。
levels.text_en: The government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong residents born in 1967 or earlier to subscribe. The Silver Bonds have a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, interest is paid once every six months, and the rate is linked to local inflation. The subscription period is from 9am on the 21st of this month to 2pm on the 4th of next month. This batch of Silver Bonds is issued under the Infrastructure Bond Programme, with a target issuance amount of HK$50 billion, and if subscription response is good, it can be increased to at most HK$55 billion. Each investor can be allotted at most 100 lots, that is HK$1 million. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the funds raised will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said issuing Silver Bonds is intended to provide the elderly with a safe, stable, low-risk investment option. The Silver Bonds will be issued on the 15th of next month; eligible people can subscribe through placing banks and designated securities brokers.

levels.text: 政府推出新一批銀色債券，供1967年或之前出生的香港居民認購。年期三年，每手一萬元，保證息率不少於4.25厘。息率每六個月派一次，並與本地通脹掛鉤。認購期由本月21日上午9時起，至下月4日下午2時止。這批銀債目標發行額為500億元，如反應理想，最多可加至550億元。每人最多可獲配發100手，即100萬元。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇說，募集所得資金會撥入基本工程儲備基金。財政司司長陳茂波說，發行銀債是想為長者提供安全、穩定、低風險的投資選擇。銀債下月15日發行。合資格人士可透過配售銀行和指定證券經紀認購。
levels.text_en: The government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong residents born in 1967 or earlier to subscribe. The term is three years, each lot costs HK$10,000, and the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%. Interest is paid once every six months and is linked to local inflation. The subscription period runs from 9am on the 21st of this month to 2pm on the 4th of next month. This batch of Silver Bonds has a target issuance amount of HK$50 billion, and if response is favourable, it can be increased to at most HK$55 billion. Each person can be allotted at most 100 lots, that is HK$1 million. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the funds raised will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said issuing Silver Bonds is intended to provide the elderly with a safe, stable, low-risk investment option. The Silver Bonds will be issued on the 15th of next month. Eligible people can subscribe through placing banks and designated securities brokers.

levels.text: 政府推出新一批 銀色債券 ，供1967年或之前出生的香港居民認購。銀債年期三年，每手一萬元，保證息率不少於4.25厘，認購期為本月21日上午9時至下月4日下午2時。   財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇今日在記者會上表示，新一批銀債每六個月派息一次，息率與本地通脹掛鉤，並保證不低於4.25厘。   本批銀債將在基礎建設債券計劃下發行，目標發行額500億元。政府會視乎認購反應，酌情將發行額上調至最多550億元。最高配發金額定為每名投資者100萬元，即每人最多可獲配發100手債券。   許正宇說，這次發行銀債募集所得資金將撥入基本工程儲備基金。   財政司司長陳茂波表示，政府今年繼續發行銀債，為長者提供安全、穩定、低風險的投資選項，同時鼓勵金融業界把握銀色經濟所帶來的商機。   銀債下月15日發行，合資格人士可於認購期內透過配售銀行和指定證券經紀認購。
levels.text_en: The government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong residents born in 1967 or earlier to subscribe. The Silver Bonds have a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, and the subscription period is from 9am on the 21st of this month to 2pm on the 4th of next month. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said at a press conference today that this new batch of Silver Bonds pays interest once every six months, the rate is linked to local inflation, and it is guaranteed to be no lower than 4.25%. This batch of Silver Bonds will be issued under the Infrastructure Bond Programme, with a target issuance amount of HK$50 billion. The government will, depending on the subscription response, at its discretion raise the issuance amount to at most HK$55 billion. The maximum allotment amount is set at HK$1 million per investor, that is each person can be allotted at most 100 lots of bonds. Hui said the funds raised from this Silver Bond issuance will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the government continues to issue Silver Bonds this year to provide the elderly with a safe, stable, low-risk investment option, while also encouraging the financial industry to seize the business opportunities brought by the silver economy. The Silver Bonds will be issued on the 15th of next month; eligible people can, during the subscription period, subscribe through placing banks and designated securities brokers.

articles.summary_en: The Hong Kong government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, a savings product for elderly residents (born in 1967 or earlier), offering a guaranteed interest rate of at least 4.25%.

articles.title: 跑馬地有私人屋苑疑有救生員用假證件　食環署已報警
articles.summary: 跑馬地一個私人屋苑有救生員疑用假證件，食環署已經報警同埋叫個泳池即刻關閉。

levels.text: 跑馬地有個私人屋苑，懷疑有救生員用假嘅救生員證件。食環署叫嗰個泳池即刻閂咗，仲考慮要告持牌人。食環署亦都報咗警，同另一個部門一齊跟進件事。原來屋苑昨日搵拯溺總會查一批救生員資料，今日發現有個救生員嘅證件同總會嘅紀錄唔一樣，所以即刻做嘢。
levels.text_en: At a private residential estate in Happy Valley, a lifeguard is suspected of using a fake lifeguard certificate. The FEHD ordered that pool to close immediately, and is considering prosecuting the licence holder. The FEHD also reported it to the police and is following up on the matter together with another department. It turns out the estate asked the Lifesaving Society yesterday to check a batch of lifeguard records, and today found that one lifeguard's certificate didn't match the Society's records, so they acted immediately.

levels.text: 跑馬地有個私人屋苑，懷疑有救生員用假嘅救生員證件。食環署已經叫嗰個泳池即刻關閉，仲考慮要向持牌人提出檢控，亦已經就件事報警，並通報物業管理業監管局一齊跟進。食環署話，屋苑喺雲地利道1至5號，昨日搵中國香港拯溺總會查一批救生員資料，今日收到結果，發現有一個當值嘅救生員，證件資料同總會嘅紀錄唔對得上，於是即刻採取行動。
levels.text_en: At a private residential estate in Happy Valley, a lifeguard is suspected of using a fake lifeguard certificate. The FEHD has ordered that pool to close immediately, is considering prosecuting the licence holder, has reported the matter to the police, and has notified the Property Management Services Authority to follow up together. The FEHD said the estate is at 1-5 Ventris Road; yesterday it asked the Hong Kong Life Saving Society to check a batch of lifeguard records, and today received the results, finding that one lifeguard on duty had certificate details that didn't match the Society's records, so it took action immediately.

levels.text: 跑馬地一個私人屋苑，懷疑有救生員使用虛假嘅救生員證件。食環署已經指示有關泳池即刻關閉，仲考慮向持牌人提出檢控，亦已就事件報警，並通報物業管理業監管局同步跟進。食環署表示，屋苑位於雲地利道1至5號，昨日向中國香港拯溺總會核實一批救生員資料，今日收到結果，發現一名喺該屋苑當值嘅救生員，證件資料同總會嘅紀錄唔符合，隨即採取行動。署方又話，由1月至上月底，人員對超過1400個持牌私人泳池巡查約7000次，並核實約2100名救生員嘅資格。
levels.text_en: At a private residential estate in Happy Valley, a lifeguard is suspected of using a false lifeguard certificate. The department also said that from January to the end of last month, staff conducted about 7,000 inspections of over 1,400 licensed private pools and verified the qualifications of about 2,100 lifeguards.

levels.text_en: At a private residential estate in Happy Valley, a lifeguard is suspected of using a false lifeguard certificate. The FEHD said the estate is located at 1-5 Ventris Road; yesterday it verified a batch of lifeguard records with the Hong Kong Life Saving Society, and today received the verification results, finding that a lifeguard on duty at the private estate concerned had certificate details that didn't match the Society's records, and acted immediately. articles.title: 鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有鹹水管滲漏　水務署正在維修
articles.summary: 水務署話鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有條鹹水管漏水，佢哋依家整緊。

levels.text: 水務署話，凌晨有人報告，話鳳德道近志蓮淨苑嗰度有條水管漏水。佢哋去睇過之後，確認呢條係鹹水管，係用嚟供沖廁水畀斧山道近瓊東街一帶。而家啲工程人員整緊，會盡快整好同恢復沖廁水，又同市民講聲對唔住。
levels.text_en: The Water Supplies Department says that in the early morning someone reported that a water pipe was leaking on Fung Tak Road near Chi Lin Nunnery. After going to look, they confirmed it was a saltwater pipe used to supply flushing water to the Hammer Hill Road area near King Tung Street. Work crews are now fixing it, will restore the flushing water supply as soon as possible, and apologize to the public.

levels.text: 水務署話，凌晨接到報告，指鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有水管滲漏。佢哋了解過之後，確認涉事嗰條水管係一條直徑三百毫米嘅鹹水供水管，係用嚟供應沖廁水畀斧山道近瓊東街一帶嘅居民。水務署話，工程團隊而家維修緊，會盡快完成呢個維修工程，同埋恢復沖廁水供應。佢哋亦都因為今次事件為市民帶嚟不便，同大家講聲對唔住。
levels.text_en: The Water Supplies Department says that in the early morning it received a report that a water pipe was leaking on Fung Tak Road near Chi Lin Nunnery. After looking into it, they confirmed the pipe involved is a 300mm-diameter saltwater supply pipe, used to supply flushing water to residents in the Hammer Hill Road area near King Tung Street. The department says the engineering team is now repairing it and will complete the repair and restore the flushing water supply as soon as possible. They also apologize to the public for the inconvenience caused by this incident.

articles.title: 無人機助監察工地熱工序和熱源
articles.summary: 勞工處試用細無人機，用紅外線鏡頭幫手搵工地入面嘅熱源同吸煙，減低火災風險。

levels.text: 勞工處試用細細部無人機，部機有紅外線鏡頭，可以幫手搵到工地入面邊度有火同高溫，減低火燭風險。由舊年十月開始，佢哋用無人機做咗六十幾次執法，仲提出咗二百幾項檢控。無人機仲可以睇到工地有冇人食煙，一發現有問題就會影相同錄影，跟進處理。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is trialling small drones. The drones have infrared cameras that help find where there is fire and high temperatures on a work site, reducing fire risk. Since last October, they have used drones for over sixty enforcement actions and raised over two hundred prosecutions. The drones can also see whether anyone on the site is smoking; once a problem is spotted, they take photos and video to follow up.

levels.text: 勞工處測試用配咗紅外線熱感應鏡頭嘅細型無人機，幫手偵測工地入面嘅熱工序同熱源，減低工地火災風險。由舊年十月起，處方已經用無人機做咗六十四次執法行動，提出二百二十四項檢控，發出六百二十三張法定通知書。勞工處嘅溫治平話，紅外線鏡頭方便職員識別熱源，之後再用攝錄鏡頭近距離睇吓熱源附近有冇易燃物體，如果發現危險情況就會派人到場跟進。上月十七日起，所有建築地盤全面禁止食煙。無人機仲可以幫手監察地盤有冇人食煙。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is testing small drones fitted with infrared thermal sensor cameras to help detect hot work processes and heat sources on work sites, reducing site fire risk. Since last October, the department has used drones for 64 enforcement actions, raised 224 prosecutions, and issued 623 statutory notices. The Labour Department's Wan Chi-ping said the infrared camera makes it easy for staff to identify heat sources, after which a video camera is used to look up close at whether there are flammable objects near the heat source; if a dangerous situation is found, people are sent to the scene to follow up. Since the 17th of last month, smoking has been completely banned on all construction sites. Drones can also help monitor whether anyone on the site is smoking.

levels.text: 勞工處測試使用配備紅外線熱感應鏡頭嘅小型無人機，協助偵測工地內嘅熱工序作業同熱源，減低工地火災風險。由去年十月起，處方已經用無人機採取六十四次執法行動，提出二百二十四項檢控，發出六百二十三張法定通知書。助理處長（職業安全）溫治平話，紅外線鏡頭方便人員識別熱源，然後透過攝錄鏡頭近距離觀察熱工序附近有冇易燃物體，若發現危險情況就會派員到場跟進。所有建築地盤上月十七日起全面禁止吸煙，實施至今勞工處巡查約一千四百個地盤，發出三十九張定額罰款通知書。無人機仲可以監察地盤有冇人吸煙，溫治平指出，若要偵測吸煙，可將感應溫度設定為攝氏六十至八十度，螢幕會喺熱源位置顯示紅點，人員發現後就會進一步蒐證。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is testing small drones equipped with infrared thermal sensor cameras to help detect hot work operations and heat sources on work sites, reducing site fire risk. Since last October, the department has taken 64 enforcement actions using drones, raised 224 prosecutions, and issued 623 statutory notices. Assistant Commissioner (Occupational Safety) Wan Chi-ping said the infrared camera makes it easy for staff to identify heat sources, and then through a video camera they observe up close whether there are flammable objects near the hot work; if a dangerous situation is found, staff are sent to the scene to follow up. Smoking has been completely banned on all construction sites since the 17th of last month; since implementation, the Labour Department has inspected about 1,400 sites and issued 39 fixed-penalty notices. Drones can also monitor whether anyone on a site is smoking. Wan Chi-ping pointed out that to detect smoking, the sensor temperature can be set to 60 to 80 degrees Celsius, and the screen will show a red dot at the heat source location; once staff spot it, they gather further evidence.

levels.text: 勞工處測試用一種小型無人機。這種無人機裝有紅外線熱感應鏡頭，可以幫忙找出工地內的熱工序和熱源，減低火災風險。由去年十月起，處方用無人機執法六十四次，提出二百二十四項檢控，發出六百二十三張通知書。助理處長溫治平說，紅外線鏡頭方便人員找出熱源，再用鏡頭近距離看看附近有沒有易燃物。所有建築地盤由上月十七日起全面禁止吸煙。到現在，勞工處已巡查約一千四百個地盤，發出三十九張罰款通知書。無人機也可以監察有沒有人吸煙。溫治平說，把感應溫度設在攝氏六十至八十度，螢幕就會在熱源位置顯示紅點，人員看到後會拍照和攝錄取證。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is testing a type of small drone. This drone is fitted with an infrared thermal sensor camera that can help find hot work processes and heat sources on a work site, reducing fire risk. Since last October, the department has carried out enforcement with drones 64 times, raised 224 prosecutions, and issued 623 notices. Assistant Commissioner Wan Chi-ping said the infrared camera makes it easy for staff to find heat sources, then the camera is used to look up close at whether there are flammable objects nearby. Smoking has been completely banned on all construction sites since the 17th of last month. Up to now, the Labour Department has inspected about 1,400 sites and issued 39 penalty notices. Drones can also monitor whether anyone is smoking. Wan Chi-ping said that by setting the sensor temperature to 60 to 80 degrees Celsius, the screen will show a red dot at the heat source location, and once staff see it they take photos and video to gather evidence.

levels.text: 勞工處測試使用配備紅外線熱感應鏡頭的小型無人機，協助偵測工地內熱工序作業和熱源，減低工地火災風險。自去年10月起，處方已使用無人機採取64次執法行動，提出224項檢控，發出623張法定通知書。   勞工處助理處長（職業安全）溫治平表示，紅外線鏡頭方便處方人員識別熱源，然後透過攝錄鏡頭近距離觀察在熱源位置的熱工序附近有否易燃物體，若發現危險情況會派員到場跟進。   所有建築地盤上月17日起全面禁止吸煙。新法例實施至今，勞工處巡查約1,400個地盤，發出39張定額罰款通知書。   無人機可協助監察地盤是否有人吸煙。溫治平指出，無人機紅外線監測的溫度可調較，若要偵測吸煙情況，可將感應溫度設定為攝氏60至80度。無人機的螢幕會在熱源位置顯示紅點，處方人員發現紅點後，會進一步蒐證，包括拍照和攝錄。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is testing the use of small drones equipped with infrared thermal sensor cameras to help detect hot work operations and heat sources on work sites, reducing site fire risk. Since October last year, the department has used drones to take 64 enforcement actions, raised 224 prosecutions, and issued 623 statutory notices. Labour Department Assistant Commissioner (Occupational Safety) Wan Chi-ping said the infrared camera makes it convenient for department staff to identify heat sources, and then through a video camera to observe up close whether there are flammable objects near the hot work at the heat source location; if a dangerous situation is found, staff will be sent to the scene to follow up. Smoking has been completely banned on all construction sites since the 17th of last month. Since the new law came into effect, the Labour Department has inspected about 1,400 sites and issued 39 fixed-penalty notices. Drones can help monitor whether anyone is smoking on a site. Wan Chi-ping noted that the temperature for drone infrared monitoring can be adjusted; to detect smoking, the sensor temperature can be set to 60 to 80 degrees Celsius. The drone's screen will show a red dot at the heat source location, and once department staff spot the red dot, they will gather further evidence, including photos and video.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong's Labour Department is testing small drones with infrared thermal cameras to spot fire hazards (hot work processes, heat sources) and smoking on construction sites, following a new full smoking ban on all building sites.

articles.title: 海關搗破深水埗南亞裔私煙集團　檢約160萬支私煙
articles.summary: 海關喺深水埗打散咗一個南亞裔私煙集團，搜到大約160萬支私煙，仲拉咗27個人。

levels.text: 海關喺深水埗搗破咗一個南亞裔私煙集團，搜到大約160萬支私煙，估計市值超過720萬蚊。今次一共拉咗27個人，入面有4個南亞裔人，佢哋懷疑係集團嘅主要人物。海關話今次喺舊樓劏房多嘅地方調查，用咗超過100人去做嘢，先至捉到呢班人。
levels.text_en: Customs broke up a South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate in Sham Shui Po, seizing about 1.6 million illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of over HK$7.2 million. A total of 27 people were arrested, including 4 South Asians suspected of being the syndicate's main figures. Customs said the investigation took place in an area with many old buildings and subdivided flats, and more than 100 officers were deployed to catch these people.

levels.text: 海關搗破咗一個活躍喺深水埗嘅南亞裔私煙集團，搜到大約160萬支私煙，估計市值超過720萬蚊，應課稅值約530萬蚊，一共拉咗27個人，入面有4個南亞裔人，懷疑係集團骨幹。海關話喺上月23日到今個月5日呢段時間，喺深水埗展開連串行動，針對買賣私煙嘅行為，多次突擊搜查同掃蕩。被拉嘅人年齡由27到82歲，有22個本地人、1個內地人同4個南亞裔人。海關仲喺區內搗破5個倉庫同3個賣私煙嘅流動檔攤。
levels.text_en: Customs broke up a South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate active in Sham Shui Po, seizing about 1.6 million illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of over HK$7.2 million and a duty potential of about HK$5.3 million. A total of 27 people were arrested, including 4 South Asians suspected of being the syndicate's core members. Customs said that between the 23rd of last month and the 5th of this month, it carried out a series of operations in Sham Shui Po targeting the buying and selling of illicit cigarettes, with repeated surprise searches and sweeps. Those arrested ranged in age from 27 to 82, comprising 22 locals, 1 mainlander and 4 South Asians. Customs also broke up 5 warehouses and 3 mobile stalls selling illicit cigarettes in the district.

levels.text: 海關搗破一個活躍喺深水埗嘅南亞裔私煙集團，檢獲大約160萬支私煙，估計市值超過720萬元，應課稅值約530萬元，拘捕27人，包括4名南亞裔人士，懷疑佢哋係集團骨幹。海關人員何詠雯話，喺上月23日至本月5日期間，喺深水埗展開連串行動，針對區內買賣私煙嘅行為，多次突擊搜查同街頭掃蕩。被捕嘅有24名男子同3名女子，年齡由27至82歲，包括22名本地人、1名內地人，以及4名持「行街紙」嘅南亞裔人士。何詠雯指，呢個集團利用區內舊樓劏房複雜嘅環境，安排人手喺大廈後巷穿插，將私煙搬到人多嘅倉庫收藏，企圖逃避調查。海關早前成立專案小組，動員超過100人採取行動。另外，喺街頭掃蕩中，海關拘捕23名買私煙嘅人，全部已被起訴。
levels.text_en: Customs broke up a South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate active in Sham Shui Po, seizing about 1.6 million illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of over HK$7.2 million and a duty potential of about HK$5.3 million, and arresting 27 people, including 4 South Asians suspected of being the syndicate's core members. Customs officer Ho Wing-man said that between the 23rd of last month and the 5th of this month, a series of operations was launched in Sham Shui Po targeting the buying and selling of illicit cigarettes in the district, with repeated surprise searches and street sweeps. Those arrested were 24 men and 3 women, aged 27 to 82, including 22 locals, 1 mainlander and 4 South Asians holding 'recognizance forms' (行街紙). Ho said the syndicate exploited the complex environment of old buildings and subdivided flats in the district, arranging people to move through building back alleys and transport illicit cigarettes to crowded warehouses for storage, in an attempt to evade investigation. Customs had earlier set up a task force, mobilizing more than 100 officers to take action. Separately, in the street sweeps, Customs arrested 23 people buying illicit cigarettes, all of whom have been charged.

levels.text: 海關搗破一個位於深水埗的南亞裔私煙集團。海關檢獲約160萬支私煙，市值估計超過720萬元，應課稅值約530萬元。行動中共拘捕27人，包括4名南亞裔人士，懷疑他們是集團骨幹。海關人員何詠雯表示，在上月23日至本月5日期間，在深水埗展開多次行動，針對買賣私煙的行為。被捕的有24名男子和3名女子，年齡由27至82歲。當中有22名本地人、1名內地人，以及4名持「行街紙」的南亞裔人士。集團利用區內舊樓劏房多的環境，安排人手在大廈後巷走動，把私煙搬到人多的倉庫收藏，企圖逃避調查。海關早前成立專案小組，動員超過100人採取行動。另外，海關在街頭掃蕩中拘捕23名買私煙的人，全部已被起訴。今年截至7月底，就購買私煙罪行，海關共起訴250人。
levels.text_en: Customs broke up a South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate located in Sham Shui Po. Customs seized about 1.6 million illicit cigarettes, with an estimated market value of over HK$7.2 million and a duty potential of about HK$5.3 million. A total of 27 people were arrested in the operation, including 4 South Asians suspected of being the syndicate's core members. Customs officer Ho Wing-man said that between the 23rd of last month and the 5th of this month, multiple operations were carried out in Sham Shui Po targeting the buying and selling of illicit cigarettes. Those arrested were 24 men and 3 women, aged 27 to 82. Among them were 22 locals, 1 mainlander and 4 South Asians holding 'recognizance forms' (行街紙). The syndicate exploited the district's environment of many old buildings and subdivided flats, arranging people to move around building back alleys and transporting illicit cigarettes to crowded warehouses for storage, in an attempt to evade investigation. Customs had earlier set up a task force, mobilizing more than 100 officers to take action. Separately, in street sweeps Customs arrested 23 people buying illicit cigarettes, all of whom have been charged. As of the end of July this year, Customs has prosecuted 250 people for the offence of buying illicit cigarettes.

levels.text: 海關搗破一個活躍在深水埗區內的南亞裔私煙集團，檢獲共約160萬支私煙，估計市值超過約720萬元，應課稅值約530萬元，拘捕27人，包括4名南亞裔人士，懷疑他們是私煙集團骨幹人物。 海關稅收罪案調查科稅收調查第二組高級調查主任何詠雯表示，在上月23日至本月5日期間，在深水埗區展開連串行動，針對區內購買和售賣私煙的行為，多次突擊搜查及街頭掃蕩。行動中，海關拘捕24名男子及3名女子，年齡介乎27至82歲，當中包括22名本地人士、1名內地人、以及4名持俗稱「行街紙」的南亞裔人士。海關又在區內搗破5個儲存倉庫，4個臨時儲藏點，以及3個售賣私煙的流動檔攤。 何詠雯指，今次搗破的南亞裔私煙集團，利用深水埗區內舊樓劏房林立的複雜環境，安排人手穿插大廈後巷，將私煙從偏遠位置倉庫，搬到人煙較為稠密的倉庫作儲藏，企圖逃避執法人員調查和跟蹤。針對這個私煙集團，海關早前成立專案小組，並在區內深入調查，動員超過100人採取連串執法行動。 另外，針對街頭買賣私煙行為，海關在進行連串街頭掃蕩中，合共拘捕23名購買私煙的人士，全部均已被落案起訴。今年截至7月底，就購買私煙罪行，海關共起訴250人。
levels.text_en: Customs broke up a South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate active within the Sham Shui Po district, seizing a total of about 1.6 million illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of over about HK$7.2 million and a duty potential of about HK$5.3 million, and arresting 27 people, including 4 South Asians suspected of being core figures of the illicit-cigarette syndicate. Ho Wing-man, Senior Investigator of the Revenue Investigation Group 2 of the Revenue Crimes Investigation Bureau, said that between the 23rd of last month and the 5th of this month, a series of operations was launched in the Sham Shui Po district targeting the buying and selling of illicit cigarettes in the district, with repeated surprise searches and street sweeps. In the operation, Customs arrested 24 men and 3 women, aged between 27 and 82, including 22 locals, 1 mainlander, and 4 South Asians holding what is commonly known as the 'recognizance form' (行街紙). Customs also broke up 5 storage warehouses, 4 temporary storage points, and 3 mobile stalls selling illicit cigarettes in the district. Ho said the South Asian illicit-cigarette syndicate broken up this time exploited the complex environment of the many old buildings and subdivided flats in Sham Shui Po, arranging people to move through building back alleys and transport illicit cigarettes from remote warehouses to more densely populated warehouses for storage, in an attempt to evade investigation and surveillance by enforcement officers. Targeting this syndicate, Customs had earlier set up a task force and conducted an in-depth investigation in the district, mobilizing more than 100 officers to take a series of enforcement actions. Separately, targeting street buying and selling of illicit cigarettes, Customs, in a series of street sweeps, arrested a total of 23 people buying illicit cigarettes, all of whom have been charged. As of the end of July this year, Customs has prosecuted 250 people for the offence of buying illicit cigarettes.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong Customs broke up an illicit-cigarette syndicate run by South Asians operating in the Sham Shui Po district, a densely built area with many old buildings subdivided into tiny flats ('subdivided units'/劏房).
