articles.title: 食環新雨衣滲水焗汗 清潔工喊苦：著又濕唔著又濕
articles.summary: 食環署啲清潔工話新雨衣會滲水又焗汗，著又濕唔著又濕，好辛苦。

levels.text: 今個夏天落好多雨，出街做嘢嘅清潔工要著雨衣擋雨。不過佢哋話食環署嘅新雨衣會滲水，裡面啲衫都濕晒，仲好焗好熱，成身汗。工友話「著又濕唔著又濕」，好辛苦。有人喺草帽上面加塊布擋雨，有人喺新雨衣外面再著多件透明雨衣，仲有人索性唔著，由得佢淋。
levels.text_en: It rained a lot this summer, so cleaning workers working outdoors have to wear raincoats to block the rain. But they say the FEHD's new raincoats leak, so the clothes underneath get soaked, and they're also stuffy and hot, leaving them drenched in sweat. Workers say 'wearing it you get wet, not wearing it you get wet too'—it's really tough. Some add a cloth on top of their straw hats to block rain, some wear another transparent raincoat over the new one, and some just don't wear it and let themselves get rained on.

levels.text: 今個夏天落雨特別多，出街做嘢嘅清潔工唯有靠雨衣擋雨。有藝術家喺網上發文，話食環署嘅新雨衣會滲水又好焗熱，用花灑試，5分鐘就濕透。食環署就話已經展開了解，有需要會睇吓設計。記者落幾個轉咗新雨衣嘅區視察，十幾個工友都話著咗新雨衣裡面啲衫一樣濕晒，仲話比舊雨衣仲嚴重，慨嘆「著又濕唔著又濕」。有工友喺草帽加塊布擋雨，有人喺新雨衣外再套件透明雨衣，甚至用垃圾袋當雨衣，有人索性唔著，由得佢淋。除咗滲水，新雨衣仲好焗，著上身成身汗，好多人都唔拉拉鍊。
levels.text_en: It rained especially much this summer, so cleaning workers working outdoors can only rely on raincoats to block rain. An artist posted online saying the FEHD's new raincoats leak and are very stuffy and hot—tested with a shower, they soak through in 5 minutes. The FEHD said it has begun looking into it and will review the design if needed. Reporters visited several districts that switched to the new raincoats; over ten workers all said the clothes under the new raincoats still get soaked, and even said it's worse than the old raincoats, lamenting 'wearing it you get wet, not wearing it you get wet too.' Some workers put a cloth on their straw hats to block rain, some wear a transparent raincoat over the new one, some even use garbage bags as raincoats, and some just don't wear it and let themselves get soaked. Besides leaking, the new raincoats are very stuffy, leaving them drenched in sweat, so many people don't zip them up.

levels.text: 今個夏天雨水特別多，過去嘅7月更加係天文台有記錄以來總雨量第二高。出街做嘢嘅清潔工唯有靠雨衣擋雨。關注勞工權益嘅藝術家Luke連日喺社交平台發文，話食環署推出嘅新雨衣出現滲水、悶熱等問題，用花灑實測5分鐘就濕透。食環署發文話已經展開了解同核實，有需要會審視設計。新雨衣由食環署同香港紡織及成衣研發中心合作，用運動服技術研發，喺旺角、大埔、葵青、荃灣同離島區率先採用。記者到幾個已轉用新雨衣嘅地區視察，十幾名工友都話雨衣完全無法擋雨，脫落嘅雨衣摸上手已濕透。有工友話制服只有兩套，唔可以同一日換，要趁中午喺垃圾站吹乾。除咗滲水，炎夏著全套仲好焗熱，成身汗，好多工友都無拉上拉鍊。
levels.text_en: It rained especially much this summer, and this past July was in fact the second-highest total rainfall on record at the Observatory. Cleaning workers working outdoors can only rely on raincoats to block rain. Luke, an artist concerned with labor rights, posted repeatedly on social media saying the FEHD's newly introduced raincoats have problems like leaking and stuffy heat, and in a shower test they soaked through in 5 minutes. The FEHD posted that it has begun looking into and verifying, and will review the design if needed. The new raincoats were jointly developed by the FEHD and the Hong Kong Research Institute of Textiles and Apparel using sportswear technology, first adopted in Mong Kok, Tai Po, Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, and the Islands district. Reporters visited several districts already using the new raincoats; over ten workers all said the raincoats completely failed to block rain, and the raincoats felt soaked to the touch when taken off. One worker said they only have two sets of uniforms and can't change on the same day, so they have to dry them at the refuse collection point at noon. Besides leaking, wearing the full set in the hot summer is very stuffy, leaving them drenched in sweat, so many workers don't zip up.

levels.text: 今個夏天雨水特別多，7月的總雨量是天文台有記錄以來第二高。清潔工要在戶外工作，唯有靠雨衣擋雨。藝術家Luke連日在網上發文，指食環署的新雨衣有滲水和悶熱的問題。他用花灑測試，發現新雨衣5分鐘就濕透。食環署回應說已經展開了解，有需要會檢視設計。新雨衣由食環署和香港紡織及成衣研發中心合作研發，在旺角、大埔、葵青、荃灣和離島區先採用。記者到幾個地區視察，十多名工友都說雨衣無法擋雨，脫下時已經濕透。有工友說制服只有兩套，要趁中午在垃圾站吹乾。除了滲水，新雨衣在夏天穿起來也很焗熱，很多工友都沒有拉上拉鍊。
levels.text_en: It rained especially much this summer; July's total rainfall was the second-highest on record at the Observatory. Cleaning workers have to work outdoors and can only rely on raincoats to block rain. Artist Luke posted repeatedly online, pointing out that the FEHD's new raincoats have leaking and stuffy-heat problems. He tested with a shower and found the new raincoats soaked through in 5 minutes. The FEHD responded that it has begun looking into it and will review the design if needed. The new raincoats were jointly developed by the FEHD and the Hong Kong Research Institute of Textiles and Apparel, first adopted in Mong Kok, Tai Po, Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, and the Islands district. Reporters visited several districts; over ten workers all said the raincoats couldn't block rain and were already soaked when taken off. One worker said they only have two sets of uniforms and have to dry them at the refuse collection point at noon. Besides leaking, the new raincoats are also very stuffy to wear in summer, so many workers don't zip them up.

levels.text: 香港紡織及成衣研發中心 創新科技署 【獨媒報導】 今個夏天雨水特別多，過去的7月更是天文台有記錄以來總雨量第二高，外出時雨傘可謂必備；不過對戶外工作的清潔工來說，雨衣是他們的唯一選擇。關注勞工權益的藝術家 Luke 連日在社交平台發文，表示食環署推出的新雨衣出現滲水、悶熱等問題，用花灑實測更5分鐘濕透。食環署則 發文 指，已展開了解及核實，再次向前線了解情況，有需要會審視設計。 新雨衣目前於5區採用，《獨媒》於日前下雨天到數區視察，十多名清潔工均表示，即使穿上新雨衣，裡面的衣服仍然濕透，指情況比舊雨衣嚴重，慨嘆「著又濕唔著又濕」。工友唯有各尋辦法擋雨，有人在草帽上縫上遮布擋雨，有人在新雨衣外再穿上一件透明雨衣，有人就索性不穿雨衣「由得佢淋」。 有工友沒有穿雨衣，使用草帽加膠袋擋雨。 有工友選擇穿上新雨衣再外搭透明雨衣。 藝術家花灑實測 5分鐘濕透 新雨衣由食物環境衞生署與香港紡織及成衣研發中心團隊合作，使用運動服技術研發，去年8月起陸續採用，現已列入新合約條款，旺角、大埔、葵青、荃灣及離島區率先採用。Luke 以花灑實測新雨衣，發現全新的新款雨衣比用了數月的新款雨衣耐水度相差甚遠，全新的在5分鐘花灑測試中可防水，使用過的雨衣則會濕透。Luke 其後用全新的新款雨衣在雨天工作45分鐘，發現衣服正面濕透，背面則較乾，估計或與剪裁有關。 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Luke Ching (@lukechinghk) Luke 穿著全新的新款雨衣在雨天工作45分鐘，發現雨衣下的衣服正面完全濕透。 衣服背面則較乾。 問題一：滲水嚴重 午休趕吹乾制服 記者到幾個已轉用新雨衣的地區視察，當日下了一整天雨，十多名工友紛紛表示雨衣完全無法擋雨。由於雨勢大，部分工友仍然選擇穿上外套，但他們脫下的雨衣摸上手已濕透，水痕清晰可見。 工友直言雨衣「個個著過都投訴」，「濕晒，著又濕唔著又濕。你摸吓，背脊濕晒。」有工友指出，因制服只有兩套，不能同一天內更換，以免「洗唔切」，所以要趁中午脫下制服在垃圾站吹乾。有工友則指下雨天要特地帶多件便服替換。 工友指著雨衣內裏的膠層，指「出水」嚴重：「好多水，著到好辛苦」；另一名工友則指將雨衣倒轉晾起時，雨水會從內裏流出來。 雨衣無用，工友唯有各尋辦法擋雨，有在草帽上縫上遮布擋雨；有在新雨衣外再套上透明雨衣，甚至以垃圾袋充當雨衣。有人就索性不穿雨衣，「由得佢淋，食飯先沖涼換衫」；或是歪頭用肩頸夾著雨傘工作，都不願被雨衣弄濕身。 有工友以垃圾袋充當雨衣。 問題二：著全套非常悶熱 除了雨衣滲水，炎夏穿著出現另一個問題，工友指新雨衣「好熱，著上去成身汗」，由於太熱，不少工友沒有拉上雨衣的拉鍊，指盡量「冇咁大雨、落冇咁長就唔著」。工友獲發的雨衣包括外套和褲裝，不過街頭觀察大部分工友沒有穿上褲裝，只是
levels.text_en: Hong Kong Research Institute of Textiles and Apparel / Innovation and Technology Commission. [InMedia Report] It rained especially much this summer, and this past July was in fact the second-highest total rainfall on record at the Observatory; when going out, an umbrella can be considered essential. But for cleaning workers working outdoors, a raincoat is their only choice. Luke, an artist concerned with labor rights, posted repeatedly on social media, saying the FEHD's newly introduced raincoats have problems like leaking and stuffy heat, and in a shower test they soaked through in 5 minutes. The FEHD posted that it has begun looking into and verifying, has again asked frontline staff about the situation, and will review the design if needed. The new raincoats are currently used in 5 districts. InMedia visited several districts on a rainy day recently; over ten cleaning workers all said that even wearing the new raincoats, the clothes underneath still got soaked, saying the situation is worse than with the old raincoats, lamenting 'wearing it you get wet, not wearing it you get wet too.' Workers can only find their own ways to block rain—some sew a rain cloth onto their straw hats, some wear a transparent raincoat over the new one, and some just don't wear a raincoat, 'letting themselves get soaked.' One worker didn't wear a raincoat and used a straw hat plus a plastic bag to block rain. Another worker chose to wear the new raincoat with a transparent raincoat over it. Artist's shower test: soaked through in 5 minutes. The new raincoats were jointly developed by the FEHD and the Hong Kong Research Institute of Textiles and Apparel team using sportswear technology, adopted progressively since last August, and now included in new contract terms, first adopted in Mong Kok, Tai Po, Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, and the Islands district. Luke tested the new raincoats with a shower and found that a brand-new new-model raincoat differed greatly in water resistance from one that had been used for a few months; the brand-new one was waterproof in a 5-minute shower test, while the used one soaked through. Luke then wore a brand-new new-model raincoat working in the rain for 45 minutes and found the front of his clothes soaked while the back was drier, guessing it might be related to the cut. [Instagram post by Luke Ching (@lukechinghk)] Luke wore a brand-new new-model raincoat working in the rain for 45 minutes and found the clothes under the raincoat completely soaked on the front. The back of the clothes was drier. Problem one: serious leaking, rushing to dry uniforms during the lunch break. Reporters visited several districts that had switched to the new raincoats; it rained all day that day, and over ten workers said one after another that the raincoats completely failed to block rain. Because the rain was heavy, some workers still chose to wear jackets, but the raincoats they took off felt soaked to the touch, with water marks clearly visible. Workers frankly said of the raincoats 'everyone who's worn them complains,' 'soaked—wearing it you get wet, not wearing it you get wet too. Feel it, my back is soaked.' One worker pointed out that since they only have two sets of uniforms, they can't change within the same day for fear of 'not being able to wash them in time,' so they have to take off the uniform and dry it at the refuse collection point at noon. Another worker said on rainy days they specially bring extra casual clothes to change into. A worker pointed at the plastic layer inside the raincoat, saying 'water seepage' was serious: 'lots of water, wearing it is really miserable'; another worker said that when hanging the raincoat upside down to dry, rainwater flows out from the inside. With the raincoats useless, workers can only find their own ways to block rain—some sew a rain cloth onto their straw hats; some wear a transparent raincoat over the new one, or even use garbage bags as raincoats. Some just don't wear a raincoat, 'letting themselves get soaked, and only shower and change at meal time'; or tilt their heads to hold an umbrella between shoulder and neck while working, unwilling to be made wet by the raincoat. One worker used a garbage bag as a raincoat. Problem two: wearing the full set is extremely stuffy. Besides the raincoat leaking, wearing it in the hot summer brings another problem—workers said the new raincoats are 'very hot, wearing them leaves your whole body sweaty.' Because it's too hot, many workers don't zip up the raincoat, saying they try to 'not wear it when there isn't much rain or it doesn't last long.' articles.summary_en: In Hong Kong, cleaning workers from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) are complaining that new raincoats, developed with a textile research center, leak water and are stifling hot. A labor-rights artist tested them and posted online; reporters visited districts to investigate during a rainy summer.

articles.title: 約34%申請人經大學聯招獲正式遴選取錄資格
articles.summary: 今年大學聯招有大約34%嘅申請人攞到正式取錄資格。

levels.text: 今年經大學聯招入大學嘅結果，今朝九點公布咗。今年有45545人申請，比舊年多咗大約5%。當中有15619人攞到正式取錄資格，即係大約三成四申請人。申請人要喺今個星期四下午五點前交留位費，仲要喺指定時間內完成註冊。
levels.text_en: This year's results for entering university through JUPAS were announced this morning at 9am. This year 45,545 people applied, about 5% more than last year. Among them, 15,619 obtained formal admission offers, which is about 34% of applicants. Applicants must pay the deposit before 5pm this Thursday, and must also complete registration within the designated time.

levels.text: 大學聯招正式遴選結果今朝九點公布。今年有45545人申請，比舊年多咗大約5%。當中15619人攞到正式取錄資格，佔申請人數大約34%。另外有4979人經SSSDP資助計劃嘅全日制學士學位課程取錄。申請人要喺今個星期四下午五點前交留位費，仲要喺指定時間內，完成取錄院校要求嘅註冊或者入學手續。
levels.text_en: The JUPAS formal selection results were announced this morning at 9am. This year 45,545 people applied, about 5% more than last year. Among them 15,619 obtained formal admission offers, making up about 34% of applicants. In addition, 4,979 people were admitted through full-time bachelor's degree programmes under the SSSDP funding scheme. Applicants must pay the deposit before 5pm this Thursday, and must also complete the registration or enrolment procedures required by the admitting institution within the designated time.

levels.text: 大學聯招辦法正式遴選結果今朝九點公布。今年有45545人申請，比上年度增加大約5%。當中15619人獲得正式取錄資格，佔申請人數大約34%。另外有4979人經SSSDP「指定專業／界別課程資助計劃」嘅全日制學士學位課程取錄。共16739名申請人獲確認名單內組別A課程嘅取錄資格，佔總數81.27%，上年度就係81.71%。申請人要喺本周四下午五點前交留位費，並喺指定期間內完成註冊或入學手續。如果覆核成績有更高等級，可以喺本月13日免費遞交一次重新考慮申請。
levels.text_en: The JUPAS formal selection results were announced this morning at 9am. This year 45,545 people applied, an increase of about 5% over last year. Among them 15,619 obtained formal admission offers, making up about 34% of applicants. In addition, 4,979 people were admitted through full-time bachelor's degree programmes under the SSSDP 'Study Subsidy Scheme for Designated Professions/Sectors'. A total of 16,739 applicants obtained admission offers for Band A programmes on their confirmed choice list, making up 81.27% of the total, compared with 81.71% last year. Applicants must pay the deposit before 5pm this Thursday, and complete the registration or enrolment procedures within the designated period. If a grade review results in a higher grade, one free application for reconsideration can be submitted on the 13th of this month.

levels.text: 大學聯招辦法正式遴選結果今早9時公布。今年有45545人申請大學聯招，較上年度增加約5%。當中15619人獲得正式遴選取錄資格，佔申請人數約34%。有4979人經SSSDP「指定專業/界別課程資助計劃」全日制學士學位課程取錄。 共16739名申請人獲已確認課程選擇名單內組別A課程的取錄資格，佔正式遴選取錄資格總數81.27%。上年度則有16923名申請人獲組別A課程取錄，佔正式遴選取錄資格總數81.71%。 申請人需在本周四下午5時前繳交留位費，於指定期間內完成取錄院校要求的註冊或入學手續。 申請成績覆核的申請人如果取得更高的科目等級，可於本月13日透過「大學聯招辦法」帳戶，免費遞交一次要求根據覆核成績重新考慮入學申請，並可按需要修改課程選擇。
levels.text_en: The JUPAS formal selection results were announced this morning at 9am. This year 45,545 people applied through JUPAS, an increase of about 5% over last year. Among them 15,619 obtained formal selection admission offers, making up about 34% of applicants. 4,979 people were admitted through full-time bachelor's degree programmes under the SSSDP 'Study Subsidy Scheme for Designated Professions/Sectors'. A total of 16,739 applicants obtained admission offers for Band A programmes on their confirmed programme choice list, making up 81.27% of the total number of formal selection admission offers. Last year 16,923 applicants were admitted to Band A programmes, making up 81.71% of the total number of formal selection admission offers. Applicants must pay the deposit before 5pm this Thursday, and complete the registration or enrolment procedures required by the admitting institution within the designated period. Applicants who applied for a grade review and obtain a higher subject grade may, on the 13th of this month, submit one free request through their JUPAS account for reconsideration of the admission application based on the reviewed results, and may modify their programme choices as needed.

articles.title: 天文台稱除非鯨魚採取靠近廣東沿岸路徑否則發一號信號機會頗低
articles.summary: 天文台話除非個風鯨魚行埋嚟廣東沿岸，唔係就好少機會出一號風球。

levels.text: 天文台話，除非個熱帶風暴鯨魚行埋去廣東沿岸嗰邊，唔係就好少機會要出一號風球。天文台話，跟返而家啲預測，鯨魚今日會喺呂宋附近轉嚟轉去，離香港有大概700公里咁遠，對香港冇乜直接威脅。天文台仲話，之後幾日香港會好熱，叫大家留意身體，小心中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says that unless Tropical Storm Krosa moves toward the Guangdong coast, there is little chance of needing to issue the No. 1 signal. The Observatory says that, according to current forecasts, Krosa will circle around near Luzon today, about 700 km from Hong Kong, posing no direct threat. It also says the next few days will be very hot, and urges everyone to take care of their health and be careful of heatstroke.

levels.text: 天文台發出特別天氣提示，話除非熱帶風暴鯨魚行埋去廣東沿岸嗰邊，唔係就好少機會要發一號戒備信號。天文台話，跟返而家嘅預測，鯨魚今日會喺呂宋附近嘅南海中部轉嚟轉去，同香港保持大概700公里或者以上嘅距離，對香港冇乜直接威脅。另一個熱帶氣旋白海豚繼續向西行，鯨魚會受白海豚影響而向東行去呂宋，同時慢慢減弱。天文台預料香港之後幾日都好熱，呼籲市民留意身體，小心中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory issued a special weather tip, saying that unless Tropical Storm Krosa moves toward the Guangdong coast, there is little chance of needing to issue the No. 1 standby signal. The Observatory says that, according to current forecasts, Krosa will circle around in the central South China Sea near Luzon today, keeping a distance of about 700 km or more from Hong Kong, posing no direct threat. Another tropical cyclone, Bailu (White Dolphin), continues to move west, and Krosa will be affected by Bailu and move east toward Luzon while gradually weakening. The Observatory expects Hong Kong to be very hot over the next few days, and urges the public to take care of their health and be careful of heatstroke.

levels.text: 天文台發出特別天氣提示，表示除非熱帶風暴鯨魚採取靠近廣東沿岸嘅路徑，否則需要發出一號戒備信號嘅機會頗低。天文台話，按照現時預測，鯨魚今日會喺呂宋附近嘅南海中部徘徊，同本港保持大約700公里或以上嘅距離，對本港直接威脅唔大。隨住另一個熱帶氣旋白海豚繼續向西移，鯨魚會受白海豚影響而向東移向呂宋，並逐漸減弱。天文台預料本港未來數日天氣酷熱，呼籲市民留意身體狀況，慎防中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory issued a special weather tip, indicating that unless Tropical Storm Krosa takes a path close to the Guangdong coast, the chance of needing to issue the No. 1 standby signal is fairly low. The Observatory says that, according to current forecasts, Krosa will linger in the central South China Sea near Luzon today, keeping a distance of about 700 km or more from Hong Kong, posing little direct threat. As another tropical cyclone, Bailu, continues to move west, Krosa will be affected by Bailu and move east toward Luzon, gradually weakening. The Observatory expects sweltering weather in Hong Kong over the next few days, and urges the public to monitor their physical condition and guard against heatstroke.

The Observatory says that, according to current forecasts, Krosa will linger today in the central South China Sea near Luzon, keeping a distance of about 700 km or more from Hong Kong, posing little direct threat. As tropical cyclone Bailu continues to move west, Krosa will be affected by Bailu and move east toward Luzon, gradually weakening. The Observatory expects sweltering weather in Hong Kong over the next few days, and urges the public to monitor their physical condition and guard against heatstroke.

articles.summary_en: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip about Tropical Storm Krosa (鯨魚, 'Whale'). It notes the storm is unlikely to require the No. 1 warning signal unless it approaches the Guangdong coast, and warns of hot weather.

articles.title: 食安中心從元朗大橋街市一個新鮮牛肉樣本檢出二氧化硫
articles.summary: 食安中心喺元朗大橋街市一個牛肉樣本，驗到唔可以用嘅防腐劑二氧化硫。

levels.text: 食安中心話，喺元朗大橋街市一個檔口攞咗個新鮮牛肉樣本去驗，發現有防腐劑二氧化硫。呢種嘢係唔可以用喺新鮮肉度嘅。中心提醒大家，唔好買啲顏色紅到怪怪哋嘅肉，要去可靠嘅檔口買，仲要食得均衡啲。
levels.text_en: The Centre for Food Safety said it took a fresh beef sample from a stall at Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long for testing and found the preservative sulphur dioxide. This substance cannot be used in fresh meat. The Centre reminds everyone not to buy meat that is suspiciously red, to buy from reliable stalls, and to eat a balanced diet.

levels.text: 食安中心公布，喺元朗大橋街市一個攤檔攞咗個新鮮牛肉樣本去化驗，結果驗到有防腐劑二氧化硫。呢種防腐劑係唔可以用喺新鮮肉類度嘅。中心而家正同涉事嘅攤檔跟進呢件違規嘅事。中心又提醒業界，一定要跟足法例，唔可以賣摻咗二氧化硫嘅新鮮同冰鮮肉類。市民就應該去可靠嘅街市檔戶或者新鮮糧食店買肉，唔好買或者食啲顏色紅到異常嘅肉，同時要注意飲食均衡。
levels.text_en: The Centre for Food Safety announced that it took a fresh beef sample from a stall at Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long for testing, and the result showed the preservative sulphur dioxide. This preservative cannot be used in fresh meat. The Centre is now following up on this violation with the stall involved. The Centre also reminds the trade that they must fully comply with the law and cannot sell fresh or chilled meat mixed with sulphur dioxide. Members of the public should buy meat from reliable market stalls or fresh provision shops, and should not buy or eat meat with an abnormally red colour, while also paying attention to a balanced diet.

levels.text: 食物安全中心公布，透過恆常食物監測計劃，喺元朗大橋街市一個攤檔攞咗個新鮮牛肉樣本去化驗。結果顯示，樣本含100萬分之785嘅二氧化硫，而呢種防腐劑係唔可以用喺新鮮肉類度嘅。中心而家正與涉事嘅街市攤檔跟進有關違規事項。中心提醒業界，必須遵守法例規定，唔可以售賣摻雜二氧化硫嘅新鮮及冰鮮肉類。市民就應該向可靠嘅街市檔戶或者新鮮糧食店買肉，切勿購買或進食顏色異常鮮紅嘅肉類。同時要注意均衡飲食，因為偏食可引致營養不良，或者攝取過多化學物。
levels.text_en: The Centre for Food Safety announced that, through its routine food surveillance programme, it took a fresh beef sample from a stall at Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long for testing. The result showed the sample contained 785 parts per million of sulphur dioxide, a preservative that cannot be used in fresh meat. The Centre is now following up on the violation with the market stall involved. The Centre reminds the trade that they must comply with legal requirements and cannot sell fresh or chilled meat mixed with sulphur dioxide. Members of the public should buy meat from reliable market stalls or fresh provision shops, and must not buy or eat meat with an abnormally bright red colour. At the same time, they should pay attention to a balanced diet, because a biased diet can lead to malnutrition or excessive intake of chemicals.

levels.text: 食物安全中心公布一宗個案。中心在元朗大橋街市一個攤檔，抽取了一個新鮮牛肉樣本化驗。結果驗出防腐劑二氧化硫，含量為100萬分之785。這種防腐劑不可用於新鮮肉類。中心正與該攤檔跟進違規事項。中心提醒業界必須遵守法例，不可售賣摻有二氧化硫的新鮮及冰鮮肉類。市民應向可靠的店舖購買肉類。切勿購買或進食顏色過分鮮紅的肉類，並要注意飲食均衡，以免營養不良或攝取過多化學物。
levels.text_en: The Centre for Food Safety announced a case. The Centre took a fresh beef sample from a stall at Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long for testing. The result detected the preservative sulphur dioxide at a content of 785 parts per million. This preservative cannot be used in fresh meat. The Centre is following up on the violation with the stall. The Centre reminds the trade that they must comply with the law and cannot sell fresh or chilled meat mixed with sulphur dioxide. Members of the public should buy meat from reliable shops. They must not buy or eat meat that is excessively bright red in colour, and should pay attention to a balanced diet, to avoid malnutrition or excessive intake of chemicals.

levels.text: 食物安全中心公布，在一個新鮮牛肉樣本檢出不可在新鮮肉類中使用的防腐劑二氧化硫。 安全中心表示，他們透過恆常食物監測計劃，從元朗大橋街市一個攤檔檢取該新鮮牛肉樣本化驗。結果顯示，樣本含100萬分之785的二氧化硫。中心正與涉事街市攤檔跟進有關違規事項。 安全中心提醒業界必須遵守法例規定，不可售賣摻雜二氧化硫的新鮮及冰鮮肉類。市民則應向可靠的街市檔戶或新鮮糧食店購買肉類，切勿購買或進食顏色異常鮮紅的肉類，同時需注意均衡飲食，因為偏食可引致營養不良或攝取過多的化學物。
levels.text_en: The Centre for Food Safety announced that a fresh beef sample was found to contain sulphur dioxide, a preservative that cannot be used in fresh meat. The Centre said that, through its routine food surveillance programme, it took the fresh beef sample from a stall at Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long for testing. The result showed the sample contained 785 parts per million of sulphur dioxide. The Centre is following up on the violation with the market stall involved. The Centre reminds the trade that they must comply with legal requirements and cannot sell fresh or chilled meat mixed with sulphur dioxide. Members of the public should buy meat from reliable market stalls or fresh provision shops, and must not buy or eat meat with an abnormally bright red colour, while also needing to pay attention to a balanced diet, because a biased diet can lead to malnutrition or excessive intake of chemicals.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety announced that a fresh beef sample from a stall at Tai Kiu Market in Yuen Long was found to contain sulphur dioxide, a preservative that is banned in fresh meat.

articles.title: 水務署稱就青山公路近屯利街水管維修工程爭取中午前恢復食水供應
articles.summary: 水務署話爭取喺中午前修好屯門條水管，恢復食水供應。

levels.text: 屯門青山公路近屯利街嗰條水管壞咗，要維修。水務署話，佢哋爭取喺中午12點前整好，恢復食水供應。嗰段行車路噚晚已經封咗，佢哋叫司機行第二條路，聽朝6點就會重開條路。
levels.text_en: The water main on Castle Peak Road near Tuen Lei Street in Tuen Mun is broken and needs repair. The Water Supplies Department says they are trying to fix it before 12 noon and restore water supply. That section of road was closed last night; they ask drivers to use another route, and the road will reopen at 6am tomorrow morning.

levels.text: 屯門青山公路近屯利街嗰條水管要維修，水務署喺社交平台發文話，因為條水管喺青山公路青山灣段北行快線同慢線中間，為咗行車安全同維修需要，由屯興路到屯利街嘅北行線，噚晚9點半已經全部封晒，叫司機行第二啲道路。水務署嘅工程團隊而家搶修緊，如果冇特別困難，就爭取喺中午12點前整好水管、恢復食水供應，聽朝6點重開條路。
levels.text_en: The water main on Castle Peak Road near Tuen Lei Street in Tuen Mun needs repair. The Water Supplies Department posted on social media that because the pipe is between the northbound fast and slow lanes on the Castle Peak Bay section of Castle Peak Road, for traffic safety and repair needs, the northbound lanes from Tuen Hing Road to Tuen Lei Street were fully closed at 9:30 last night, and drivers are asked to use other roads. The department's engineering team is now doing emergency repairs; if there are no special difficulties, they aim to fix the pipe and restore water supply before 12 noon, and reopen the road at 6am tomorrow morning.

levels.text: 就屯門青山公路近屯利街嘅水管維修工程，水務署表示爭取喺中午12時前恢復食水供應，聽朝重開有關行車路。水務署喺社交平台發文，指相關水管位於青山公路青山灣段北行快線同慢線之間，為咗保障行車安全同維修需要，青山公路青山灣段由屯興路至屯利街嘅北行線，已經喺噚晚9時半全線封閉，呼籲駕駛人士改用其他道路。署方工程團隊正搶修緊，除非遇上特別嘅工程困難，例如惡劣天氣影響，否則爭取喺中午12時前完成緊急水管維修同恢復食水供應，並於聽朝6時重開該段行車路。
levels.text_en: Regarding the water main repair works on Castle Peak Road near Tuen Lei Street in Tuen Mun, the Water Supplies Department says it aims to restore water supply before 12 noon and reopen the road tomorrow morning. In a social media post, the department said the pipe is located between the northbound fast and slow lanes on the Castle Peak Bay section of Castle Peak Road. To safeguard traffic safety and for repair needs, the northbound lanes on the Castle Peak Bay section from Tuen Hing Road to Tuen Lei Street were fully closed at 9:30 last night, and drivers are urged to use other roads. The department's engineering team is doing emergency repairs; unless they encounter special engineering difficulties, such as bad weather, they aim to complete the emergency water main repair and restore water supply before 12 noon, and reopen that section of road at 6am tomorrow morning.

levels.text: 屯門青山公路近屯利街的水管正在維修。水務署表示，希望在中午12時前恢復食水供應，並於明早重開道路。這條水管在青山公路青山灣段北行快線和慢線之間。為了行車安全和維修需要，由屯興路至屯利街的北行線已在昨晚9時半全線封閉。署方叫司機改行其他道路。工程團隊正在搶修，若沒有特別困難，例如天氣惡劣，就爭取在中午12時前完成，並在明早6時重開道路。

This water main is between the northbound fast and slow lanes on the Castle Peak Bay section of Castle Peak Road. levels.text: 就屯門青山公路近屯利街的水管維修工程，水務署表示爭取於中午12時前恢復食水供應，並於明早重開有關行車路。 水務署在社交平台發文，指由於相關水管位於青山公路青山灣段北行快線及慢線之間，為保障行車安全及水管維修需要，青山公路青山灣段由屯興路至屯利街的北行線，已於昨晚9時半全線封閉，呼籲駕駛人士改用其他道路。 署方工程團隊正在搶修，除非遇上特別的工程困難，如惡劣天氣影響等，爭取於中午12時前完成緊急水管維修工程及恢復食水供應，並於明早6時重開該段行車路。
levels.text_en: Regarding the water main repair works on Castle Peak Road near Tuen Lei Street in Tuen Mun, the Water Supplies Department says it aims to restore water supply before 12 noon and reopen the relevant road tomorrow morning. In a social media post, the department said that because the pipe is located between the northbound fast and slow lanes on the Castle Peak Bay section of Castle Peak Road, to safeguard traffic safety and for water main repair needs, the northbound lanes on the Castle Peak Bay section from Tuen Hing Road to Tuen Lei Street were fully closed at 9:30 last night, and drivers are urged to use other roads. The department's engineering team is doing emergency repairs; unless they encounter special engineering difficulties, such as effects of bad weather, they aim to complete the emergency water main repair works and restore water supply before 12 noon, and reopen that section of road at 6am tomorrow morning.

articles.title: 香港船東會稱約有70至80艘會員船隻滯留波斯灣及霍爾木茲海峽
articles.summary: 香港船東會話，大約有70到80艘會員船仲喺波斯灣同霍爾木茲海峽走唔到。

levels.text: 中東而家仲好亂，好多船喺波斯灣同霍爾木茲海峽走唔到。香港船東會話，大約有70到80艘會員船仲喺嗰度，有成1400到1600個船員受影響。船東會話，最緊要係保護船員安全，仲要有夠嘅食物畀佢哋食。如果要改行第二條路，行遠咗成本會貴，最後要消費者畀多啲錢。
levels.text_en: The Middle East is still chaotic, and many ships can't get out of the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. The Hong Kong Shipowners Association says about 70 to 80 member ships are still there, affecting some 1,400 to 1,600 crew members. The association says the most important thing is to protect crew safety and to have enough food for them. If they have to take another route, the longer distance raises costs, and in the end consumers have to pay more.

levels.text: 中東局勢而家仲未清晰，波斯灣同霍爾木茲海峽嘅航運情況好多人關注。香港船東會主席宋睿之話，估計而家大約有70到80艘會員船仲滯留喺嗰啲海域，受影響嘅船員大約有1400到1600人。船東會副主席林詩鍵話，最緊要係確保船員安全，同埋船上有夠食物。佢話航道遇到阻礙唔代表冇辦法應對，不過改航道會令航程變遠，成本上升，最後只能夠轉嫁畀消費者。
levels.text_en: The situation in the Middle East is still unclear, and many people are watching shipping conditions in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. Hong Kong Shipowners Association chairman Sung Yui-chi says an estimated 70 to 80 member ships are still stranded in those waters, with about 1,400 to 1,600 crew members affected. Vice-chairman Lam Sze-kin says the most important thing is ensuring crew safety and having enough food on board. He says an obstructed route doesn't mean there's no way to cope, but changing routes makes voyages longer and raises costs, which in the end can only be passed on to consumers.

levels.text: 中東局勢仍然未明朗，波斯灣同霍爾木茲海峽嘅航運情況備受關注。香港船東會主席宋睿之表示，根據估算，現時大約有70到80艘會員船隻仲滯留喺相關海域，受影響嘅船員大約有1400到1600人。船東會常務副主席林詩鍵話，首要工作係確保船員人身安全，同埋船上有充足食物。佢話航道遇到阻礙唔代表冇應對方案，但係改航道會令航程變遠，導致成本上升，最終只能夠轉嫁畀消費者。另外，船東會亦就施政報告向政府提出多項建議，包括推廣香港海事品牌、加強國際合作、堅守自由貿易同航道暢通等核心價值。
levels.text_en: The Middle East situation remains unclear, and shipping conditions in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz are drawing attention. Hong Kong Shipowners Association chairman Sung Yui-chi says that, based on estimates, about 70 to 80 member ships are currently still stranded in the relevant waters, with about 1,400 to 1,600 crew members affected. Executive vice-chairman Lam Sze-kin says the top priority is ensuring crew members' personal safety and having sufficient food on board. He says an obstructed route doesn't mean there's no response plan, but changing routes makes voyages longer, leading to higher costs that in the end can only be passed on to consumers. Separately, the association also made several suggestions to the government regarding the Policy Address, including promoting the Hong Kong maritime brand, strengthening international cooperation, and upholding core values such as free trade and open shipping lanes.

levels.text: 中東局勢仍然未清晰，波斯灣同霍爾木茲海峽嘅航運情況受人關注。香港船東會主席宋睿之說，估計現時大約有70到80艘會員船隻仍然滯留喺相關海域，受影響嘅船員大約有1400到1600人。副主席林詩鍵說，最緊要係保障船員安全，並且船上要有充足食物。他說航道遇到阻礙，唔代表冇辦法應付，但改航道會令航程變遠，成本上升，最後只能轉嫁畀消費者。另外，船東會亦向政府提出多項建議，包括推廣香港海事品牌、加強國際合作、推動綠色航運等。
levels.text_en: The Middle East situation remains unclear, and shipping conditions in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz are drawing attention. Hong Kong Shipowners Association chairman Sung Yui-chi said an estimated 70 to 80 member ships are currently still stranded in the relevant waters, with about 1,400 to 1,600 crew members affected. Vice-chairman Lam Sze-kin said the most important thing is safeguarding crew safety and having sufficient food on board. He said an obstructed route doesn't mean there's no way to cope, but changing routes makes voyages longer and raises costs, which in the end can only be passed on to consumers. Separately, the association also made several suggestions to the government, including promoting the Hong Kong maritime brand, strengthening international cooperation, and advancing green shipping.

levels.text: 中東局勢仍未明朗，波斯灣及霍爾木茲海峽的航運情況備受關注。香港船東會主席宋睿之表示，根據船東會的估算，現時大約有70至80艘會員船隻仍滯留在相關海域，受影響的船員約有1400至1600人。 船東會常務副主席林詩鍵表示，首要工作是確保船員的人身安全和船上有充足食物。他說，航運的航道遇到阻礙，並不代表沒有應對方案，但更改航道會令航程變遠，導致成本上升，最終只能轉嫁消費者。 另外，香港船東會就首份香港五年規劃及新一份施政報告，向政府提出多項建議，包括建議利用香港的金融優勢制定跨行業政策；推廣香港海事品牌，善用全球經濟格局轉變及國家「雙循環」政策所帶來的新機遇；加強國際合作，堅守自由貿易、航道暢通等核心價值等。 船東會又建議特區政府，尋求其他司法管轄區撤銷貿易壁壘，推動綠色轉型，加快本地船舶岸電轉型，減低船隻停泊期間的排放，與其他主要港口共同發展綠色航運走廊等。
levels.text_en: The Middle East situation remains unclear, and shipping conditions in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz are drawing much attention. Hong Kong Shipowners Association chairman Sung Yui-chi said that, according to the association's estimates, about 70 to 80 member ships are currently still stranded in the relevant waters, with about 1,400 to 1,600 crew members affected. Executive vice-chairman Lam Sze-kin said the top priority is ensuring crew members' personal safety and having sufficient food on board. He said that an obstructed shipping route does not mean there is no response plan, but changing routes makes voyages longer, leading to higher costs that in the end can only be passed on to consumers. Separately, regarding the first Hong Kong five-year plan and the latest Policy Address, the Hong Kong Shipowners Association made several suggestions to the government, including using Hong Kong's financial advantages to formulate cross-industry policies; promoting the Hong Kong maritime brand and making good use of new opportunities from shifts in the global economic landscape and the country's 'dual circulation' policy; and strengthening international cooperation and upholding core values such as free trade and open shipping lanes. The association also suggested the SAR government seek the removal of trade barriers in other jurisdictions, promote green transition, speed up local ships' switch to shore power to reduce emissions while berthed, and jointly develop green shipping corridors with other major ports.

articles.summary_en: The Hong Kong Shipowners Association reports on ships stuck in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing Middle East instability, and offers policy suggestions to the government.

articles.title: 7月樓宇買賣跌28.8%
articles.summary: 上個月樓宇買賣少咗好多，跌咗差唔多三成。

levels.text: 土地註冊處話，上個月啲樓宇買賣少咗好多。全部合共有六千七百幾份買賣合約，比上個月跌咗百分之二十八點八，比舊年同期又跌咗百分之六點九。啲合約加埋總共值五百一十七億元，都係跌咗好多。
levels.text_en: The Land Registry says property sales dropped a lot last month. There were over six thousand seven hundred sale contracts in total, down 28.8% from the previous month, and down 6.9% from the same period last year. The contracts were worth 51.7 billion dollars in total, also a big drop.

levels.text: 土地註冊處公布，上個月全港樓宇買賣合約總共有六千七百一十五份，比上個月跌咗百分之二十八點八，比舊年同期又跌咗百分之六點九。啲合約加埋總值五百一十七億元，比上個月跌咗百分之三十七點五。當中住宅樓宇嘅買賣合約有四千四百六十二份，比上個月跌咗百分之四十一點七，跌得幾勁。
levels.text_en: The Land Registry announced that last month there were 6,715 property sale contracts across Hong Kong, down 28.8% from the previous month, and down 6.9% from the same period last year. The contracts were worth 51.7 billion dollars in total, down 37.5% from the previous month. Among these, residential property sale contracts numbered 4,462, down 41.7% from the previous month, quite a steep drop.

levels.text: 土地註冊處公布，上個月全港樓宇買賣合約總共有六千七百一十五份，按月跌百分之二十八點八，按年亦跌百分之六點九；合約總值五百一十七億元，按月跌百分之三十七點五，按年亦跌百分之五點三。當中，住宅樓宇買賣合約佔四千四百六十二份，按月跌百分之四十一點七，按年亦跌百分之二十二點六。不過，月內市民查冊次數就升咗好多，總共一百四十六萬幾次，按月升百分之一百九十點二。
levels.text_en: The Land Registry announced that last month there were 6,715 property sale contracts across Hong Kong, down 28.8% month-on-month and also down 6.9% year-on-year; the contracts totaled 51.7 billion dollars, down 37.5% month-on-month and also down 5.3% year-on-year. Among these, residential property sale contracts accounted for 4,462, down 41.7% month-on-month and also down 22.6% year-on-year. However, the number of title searches by the public rose a lot during the month, totaling over 1.46 million, up 190.2% month-on-month.

levels.text: 土地註冊處公布，上月全港樓宇買賣合約共六千七百一十五份。這個數字比上月跌百分之二十八點八，也比去年同期跌百分之六點九。合約總值五百一十七億元，同樣下跌。當中住宅買賣合約有四千四百六十二份，跌幅更大。不過，市民查冊的次數就大升，全月共一百四十六萬多次。
levels.text_en: The Land Registry announced that last month there were 6,715 property sale contracts across Hong Kong. This figure was down 28.8% from the previous month, and also down 6.9% from the same period last year. The contracts totaled 51.7 billion dollars, likewise a decline. Among these, residential sale contracts numbered 4,462, an even bigger drop. However, the number of title searches by the public rose sharply, totaling over 1.46 million for the whole month.

levels.text: 土地註冊處公布，上月樓宇買賣合約共6,715份，按月跌28.8%，按年也跌6.9%；合約總值517億元，按月跌37.5%，按年也跌5.3%。   其中，住宅樓宇買賣合約佔4,462份，按月跌41.7%，按年也跌22.6%；合約總值419億元，按月跌44.6%，按年也跌9.6%。   月內市民查冊1,466,737次，按月升190.2%，按年也升246%。
levels.text_en: The Land Registry announced that last month there were 6,715 property sale contracts, down 28.8% month-on-month and also down 6.9% year-on-year; the contracts totaled 51.7 billion dollars, down 37.5% month-on-month and also down 5.3% year-on-year. Among these, residential property sale contracts accounted for 4,462, down 41.7% month-on-month and also down 22.6% year-on-year; totaling 41.9 billion dollars, down 44.6% month-on-month and also down 9.6% year-on-year. During the month the public made 1,466,737 title searches, up 190.2% month-on-month and also up 246% year-on-year.

articles.summary_en: Monthly property transaction data from Hong Kong's Land Registry, showing a sharp drop in July sales.

articles.title: 丘應樺：全力推進北都建設　持續完善數字基礎提供可靠算力支持
articles.summary: 商務局局長丘應樺話，政府會全力發展北部都會區，仲會做好算力同人工智能，令香港成為創新科技中心。

levels.text: 商務局局長丘應樺話，人工智能、網絡同算力好重要，可以幫到香港發展創新科技。政府而家全力起緊北部都會區，想將佢變成一個新嘅創新科技城。政府仲會做好數字基礎，為好多公司同科研提供穩定嘅算力，等香港成為國際創新科技中心。
levels.text_en: Secretary for Commerce Algernon Yau said that artificial intelligence, networks and computing power are very important and can help Hong Kong develop innovation and technology. The government is now working hard to build the Northern Metropolis, wanting to turn it into a new innovation and technology city. The government will also improve digital infrastructure, providing stable computing power for many companies and scientific research, so that Hong Kong becomes an international innovation and technology centre.

levels.text: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺話，國家「十五五」規劃提到要培育新興產業，特區政府而家準備緊香港第一份五年規劃，配合國家發展方向。佢話人工智能、網絡同算力三者互相配合，係推動創新科技好重要嘅基礎。政府正全力起緊北部都會區，想將佢變成國際創新科技新城，仲會不斷完善數字基礎，為人工智能同科研提供穩定可靠嘅算力。另外政府亦積極為6G時代做好準備，仲會鼓勵企業用人工智能去升級轉型。
levels.text_en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the nation's 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan' mentions cultivating emerging industries, and the SAR government is now preparing Hong Kong's first five-year plan to match the nation's development direction. He said AI, networks and computing power work together and are an important foundation for driving innovation and technology. The government is working hard to build the Northern Metropolis, wanting to turn it into a new international innovation and technology city, and will keep improving digital infrastructure to provide stable and reliable computing power for AI and scientific research. Additionally, the government is actively preparing for the 6G era and will encourage enterprises to use AI to upgrade and transform.

levels.text: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺話，國家「十五五」規劃綱要提出要培育新興產業同未來產業，特區政府正積極準備香港首份五年規劃，配合國家發展方向。佢話人工智能、網絡同算力三者相輔相成，係推動高質量發展嘅重要基石，亦係香港建設國際創新科技中心不可或缺嘅核心動能。丘應樺出席一個科技論壇時話，算力係人工智能發展嘅重要基礎，對推動科研創新同產業數字化轉型都有關鍵作用。政府正全力推進北部都會區建設，將佢建成國際創新科技新城，亦持續完善數字基礎，為企業提供穩定可靠嘅算力支持。此外政府亦積極為6G時代做好準備，仲會透過專項基金資助企業應用人工智能升級轉型。
levels.text_en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the outline of the nation's 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan' proposes cultivating emerging industries and future industries, and the SAR government is actively preparing Hong Kong's first five-year plan to match the nation's development direction. He said AI, networks and computing power complement each other and are an important cornerstone for driving high-quality development, and are also an indispensable core driving force for Hong Kong's building of an international innovation and technology centre. Speaking at a technology forum, Yau said computing power is an important foundation for AI development and plays a key role in driving research innovation and industrial digital transformation. The government is fully advancing the construction of the Northern Metropolis, building it into a new international innovation and technology city, and continuing to improve digital infrastructure to provide stable and reliable computing power support for enterprises. In addition, the government is actively preparing for the 6G era and will use a dedicated fund to subsidise enterprises applying AI to upgrade and transform.

levels.text: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺表示，國家「十五五」規劃提出要發展新興產業。特區政府正在準備香港首份五年規劃，以配合國家的發展方向。他說，人工智能、網絡和算力互相配合，是推動創新科技的重要基礎。政府正全力建設北部都會區，希望把它建成國際創新科技新城。政府亦持續完善數字基礎，為企業和科研提供穩定可靠的算力。此外，政府積極為6G時代做好準備，並在今年6月透過一項基金落實新措施，資助企業應用人工智能升級轉型。丘應樺相信，香港能夠發揮優勢，把握人工智能時代的新機遇，鞏固國際創新科技中心的地位。
levels.text_en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the nation's 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan' proposes developing emerging industries. The SAR government is preparing Hong Kong's first five-year plan to match the nation's development direction. He said AI, networks and computing power work together and are an important foundation for driving innovation and technology. The government is fully building the Northern Metropolis, hoping to build it into a new international innovation and technology city. The government is also continuing to improve digital infrastructure to provide stable and reliable computing power for enterprises and scientific research. In addition, the government is actively preparing for the 6G era, and in June this year implemented new measures through a fund to subsidise enterprises applying AI to upgrade and transform. Yau believes Hong Kong can leverage its strengths, seize the new opportunities of the AI era, and consolidate its position as an international innovation and technology centre.

levels.text: 商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺表示，國家「十五五」規劃綱要提出培育壯大新興產業及未來產業，特區政府正積極籌備香港首份五年規劃，對接國家發展方向。而人工智能、網絡和算力三者相輔相成，是培育新質生產力和推動高質量發展的重要基石，亦是香港建設國際創新科技中心不可或缺的核心動能。 丘應樺出席一個科技論壇時表示，算力作為人工智能發展的重要基礎，對推動科研創新、促進創新成果轉化以及加快產業數字化轉型，都發揮關鍵作用。特區政府正全力推進北部都會區建設，將北都建設成國際創新科技新城，亦正持續完善數字基礎，為人工智能、科研創新及企業數字化轉型，提供穩定可靠的算力支持。 另外，特區政府致力為通訊業界提供有利的營商環境和多元的支援措施，積極為6G時代做好準備，為經濟發展持續注入新動能。政府亦在不同層面鼓勵企業透過應用人工智能升級轉型，商務及經濟發展局今年6月在一項專項基金下，落實一系列優化措施，為企業推行涵蓋人工智能應用的項目，提供更具針對性的資助，協助企業升級轉型。 丘應樺說，人工智能、網絡及算力，未來將持續重塑全球經濟格局，亦為香港帶來前所未有的發展新機遇，相信在政府、通訊業界及各界持份者合作下，香港定能夠發揮優勢，以創新科技驅動新質生產力的發展，亦是把握人工智能時代帶來的新機遇，鞏固香港作為國際創新科技中心的地位。
levels.text_en: Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the outline of the nation's 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan' proposes cultivating and strengthening emerging industries and future industries, and the SAR government is actively preparing Hong Kong's first five-year plan to align with the nation's development direction. AI, networks and computing power complement each other and are an important cornerstone for cultivating new quality productive forces and driving high-quality development, and are also an indispensable core driving force for Hong Kong's building of an international innovation and technology centre. Speaking at a technology forum, Yau said that computing power, as an important foundation for AI development, plays a key role in driving research innovation, promoting the transformation of innovation results, and accelerating industrial digital transformation. The SAR government is fully advancing the construction of the Northern Metropolis, building it into a new international innovation and technology city, and is continuing to improve digital infrastructure to provide stable and reliable computing power support for AI, research innovation and enterprise digital transformation. In addition, the SAR government is committed to providing a favourable business environment and diverse support measures for the communications industry, actively preparing for the 6G era to continuously inject new momentum into economic development. The government also encourages enterprises at different levels to upgrade and transform through applying AI; in June this year the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau implemented a series of enhancement measures under a dedicated fund, providing more targeted subsidies for enterprises carrying out projects covering AI applications to help them upgrade and transform. Yau said AI, networks and computing power will continue to reshape the global economic landscape in the future, and also bring Hong Kong unprecedented new development opportunities. He believes that with cooperation among the government, the communications industry and stakeholders from all sectors, Hong Kong can leverage its strengths, drive the development of new quality productive forces through innovation and technology, seize the new opportunities brought by the AI era, and consolidate Hong Kong's position as an international innovation and technology centre.

articles.summary_en: Algernon Yau, Hong Kong's Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development, speaks at a technology forum about developing AI, networks and computing power, and building up the Northern Metropolis as an innovation and technology hub. The 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan' is China's national development plan.

articles.title: 陳國基鼓勵機電工程營運基金為香港高質量發展注入持久動能
articles.summary: 政務司司長陳國基話機電工程營運基金成立咗三十年，鼓勵佢哋繼續創新，為香港發展出力。

levels.text: 政務司司長陳國基做咗機電工程營運基金三十周年典禮嘅主持。佢話呢個基金成立咗三十年，由以前主要係整機電嘅設備，變成而家幫各個政府部門睇住啲機電設施同埋帶頭創新。佢仲鼓勵基金繼續搞新嘢，做到最好，等市民享受更好、更方便嘅服務，同時為香港發展出力。
levels.text_en: Chief Secretary Eric Chan hosted the 30th anniversary ceremony of the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund. He said the fund has been established for 30 years, changing from mainly making electrical and mechanical equipment before to now helping various government departments look after electrical and mechanical facilities and leading in innovation. He also encouraged the fund to keep doing new things and be the best, so citizens can enjoy better, more convenient services, and at the same time contribute to Hong Kong's development.

levels.text: 政務司司長陳國基主持咗機電工程營運基金三十周年典禮。佢喺致辭嗰陣話，呢個基金成立咗三十年，以前主要係負責維修機電設備，而家已經變成各個政府部門嘅「機電設施守護者」同「創新促成者」，一直帶頭推動公共服務行向數字化同智能化。陳國基又鼓勵基金繼續勇於創新，做到最好，幫各個政府部門加快用創新科技，等市民享受到更優質、更方便嘅服務，同時為香港高質量發展注入持久嘅動力。機電署署長潘國英亦致辭，話會繼續用創科帶動行業革新，同客戶部門一齊做好公共服務。
levels.text_en: Chief Secretary Eric Chan hosted the 30th anniversary ceremony of the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund. In his speech he said the fund has been established for 30 years; before it was mainly responsible for maintaining electrical and mechanical equipment, and now it has become the "guardian of electrical and mechanical facilities" and "enabler of innovation" for various government departments, all along leading the push of public services toward digitalization and intelligence. Chan also encouraged the fund to keep being bold in innovation and be the best, helping various government departments speed up the use of innovative technology, so citizens can enjoy higher-quality, more convenient services, and at the same time injecting lasting momentum into Hong Kong's high-quality development. The Director of Electrical and Mechanical Services, Pun Kwok-ying, also spoke, saying they will continue to use innovation and technology to drive industry reform and work with client departments to do public services well.

levels.text: 政務司司長陳國基主持機電工程營運基金三十周年紀念典禮。佢致辭時話，呢個基金成立三十年，由最初主要負責維修機電設備，發展成為各政府部門嘅「機電設施守護者」同「創新促成者」，而且一直以先行者嘅角色，積極推動公共服務數字化同智能化轉型。陳國基又鼓勵營運基金繼續勇於創新，精益求精，協助各政府部門加快應用創新科技，等市民享受更優質、更便捷嘅服務，同時為香港高質量發展注入持久動能。機電署署長兼營運基金總經理潘國英致辭時話，營運基金會以機電智能化提升服務質素同效能，以創科引領行業革新，同客戶部門同心協力，落實各個創新構想，成就更優質嘅公共服務。
levels.text_en: Chief Secretary Eric Chan officiated at the 30th anniversary commemorative ceremony of the Electrical and Mechanical Services Trading Fund. In his speech he said the fund has been established for 30 years; from initially being mainly responsible for maintaining electrical and mechanical equipment, it developed into the "guardian of electrical and mechanical facilities" and "enabler of innovation" for various government departments, and has all along, in a pioneering role, actively promoted the digital and intelligent transformation of public services. Chan also encouraged the trading fund to keep being bold in innovation and strive for excellence, assisting various government departments in speeding up the application of innovative technology, so citizens can enjoy higher-quality, more convenient services, and at the same time injecting lasting momentum into Hong Kong's high-quality development. The Director of Electrical and Mechanical Services and General Manager of the trading fund, Pun Kwok-ying, said in his speech that the trading fund will use electrical and mechanical intelligence to raise service quality and effectiveness, lead industry reform with innovation and technology, work hand in hand with client departments to implement various innovative ideas, and achieve better-quality public services.

Initially it was mainly responsible for maintaining electrical and mechanical equipment; now it has become the "guardian of electrical and mechanical facilities" and "enabler of innovation" for various government departments. articles.title: 男僱員從九龍城改建中樓宇天台樓邊墮下不治　勞工處要求停用天台
articles.summary: 一個男工人喺九龍城一幢改建緊嘅樓宇天台跌落嚟，救唔返，勞工處叫停用個天台。

levels.text: 下午喺九龍城一個地盤，有個男工人喺改建緊嘅樓宇天台做嘢，佢喺天台樓邊高處跌咗落嚟，送咗去醫院之後證實救唔返。勞工處好難過，同佢屋企人講聲慰問。勞工處已經叫個承建商停用嗰個天台，等安全咗先可以再開工。
levels.text_en: In the afternoon at a construction site in Kowloon City, a male worker was working on the rooftop of a building being renovated. He fell from a high point at the edge of the roof, and after being taken to hospital he could not be saved. The Labour Department is very sad and expressed condolences to his family. The Labour Department has already told the contractor to stop using that rooftop, and work can only resume once it's made safe.

levels.text: 下午喺九龍城一個建築地盤，發生咗一單好嚴重嘅工作意外。有個男僱員喺一幢改建緊嘅樓宇天台做嘢，佢喺天台樓邊高處跌咗落嚟，送咗去醫院之後證實救唔返。勞工處好關注呢件事，亦都好難過，同死者屋企人講聲慰問。勞工處話，意外之後已經即刻派人去現場調查，仲向承建商發出「暫時停工通知書」，叫佢哋停用嗰幢改建樓宇嘅天台。要等承建商做好安全措施、消除危險，先可以再開工。勞工處而家全速查緊意外點解會發生，如果發現有人犯規，一定會依法處理。
levels.text_en: In the afternoon at a construction site in Kowloon City, a very serious work accident happened. A male employee was working on the rooftop of a building under renovation. He fell from a high point at the edge of the roof, and after being taken to hospital he could not be saved. The Labour Department is very concerned about this and also very sad, and expressed condolences to the deceased's family. The Labour Department said that after the accident it immediately sent people to investigate at the scene, and issued a 'Suspension Notice' to the contractor, telling them to stop using the rooftop of that renovated building. Work can only resume after the contractor has put safety measures in place and removed the danger. The Labour Department is now investigating at full speed why the accident happened, and if it finds anyone broke the rules, it will definitely handle it according to law.

levels.text: 勞工處高度關注下午喺九龍城一個建築地盤發生嘅致命工作意外。一名男僱員喺一幢改建中嘅樓宇天台工作期間，喺天台樓邊高處墮下，送院之後證實不治。勞工處對此十分難過，亦向死者家屬致以慰問。發言人話，意外之後已即刻派人到現場調查，並向承建商發出「暫時停工通知書」，停止使用該改建樓宇嘅天台，要等承建商採取適當措施、消除危害，先可以復工。勞工處正全速調查意外成因，查明有關持責者嘅法律責任，如發現有違例事項，一定會依法處理。勞工處亦提醒僱主，必須採取足夠嘅預防措施，包括為工人提供安全通道，並將所有危險邊緣圍封好；如做唔到，亦應為工人提供全身式安全帶，接駁喺穩固嘅繫穩點或救生繩上，保障高處工作安全。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is highly concerned about a fatal work accident that happened in the afternoon at a construction site in Kowloon City. A male employee, while working on the rooftop of a building under renovation, fell from a high point at the edge of the roof, and after being taken to hospital was confirmed dead. The Labour Department is very sad about this and extended condolences to the deceased's family. A spokesperson said that after the accident it immediately sent people to investigate at the scene, and issued a 'Suspension Notice' to the contractor, stopping use of that renovated building's rooftop; work can only resume after the contractor takes appropriate measures and removes the hazard. The Labour Department is investigating the cause of the accident at full speed and looking into the legal responsibility of those responsible, and if it finds any violations it will definitely handle it according to law. The Labour Department also reminds employers that they must take adequate preventive measures, including providing workers with safe access and fencing off all dangerous edges; if that cannot be done, they should provide workers with a full-body safety harness connected to a secure anchor point or lifeline, to protect safety when working at height.

levels.text: 勞工處十分關注一宗致命工作意外。事件下午在九龍城一個建築地盤發生。一名男僱員在一幢改建中的樓宇天台工作，期間在天台樓邊高處墮下。他送院後證實不治。勞工處對事件感到難過，並向死者家屬慰問。發言人說，意外後已即時派人到現場調查，並向承建商發出停工通知書。承建商要停用該天台，直至做好安全措施、消除危險，才可復工。勞工處正全力調查意外原因，追查責任，如發現違例，會依法處理。勞工處提醒僱主，一定要做足預防措施，例如為工人提供安全通道，並圍封好危險邊緣。如做不到，也應為工人提供全身式安全帶，扣在穩固的繫穩點或救生繩上，以保障高處工作安全。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is very concerned about a fatal work accident. The incident happened in the afternoon at a construction site in Kowloon City. A male employee was working on the rooftop of a building under renovation, and during this fell from a high point at the edge of the roof. He was confirmed dead after being taken to hospital. The Labour Department is sad about the incident and offered condolences to the deceased's family. A spokesperson said that after the accident people were immediately sent to investigate at the scene, and a suspension notice was issued to the contractor. The contractor must stop using that rooftop until safety measures are done and the danger removed, before work can resume. The Labour Department is fully investigating the cause of the accident and pursuing responsibility; if violations are found, it will handle them according to law. The Labour Department reminds employers that they must take full preventive measures, for example providing workers with safe access and fencing off dangerous edges well. If that cannot be done, they should also provide workers with a full-body safety harness fastened to a secure anchor point or lifeline, to protect safety when working at height.

levels.text: 勞工處高度關注下午在九龍城一個建築地盤內發生的致命工作意外，一名男僱員在改建中樓宇的天台工作期間從樓邊高處墮下，送院後證實不治，處方對此十分難過，並對家屬致以深切慰問。 發言人表示，勞工處在意外後已即時派員到意外現場展開調查，並已向有關承建商發出「暫時停工通知書」，停止使用該改建樓宇的天台，直至信納有關承建商已採取適當的措施消除有關危害，才可復工。勞工處正全速調查確定意外成因，查找有關持責者的法律責任，以及提出改善措施，如果調查發現有違例事項，定會依法處理。 勞工處提醒，僱主必須採取足夠的預防措施，包括向工人提供適當及足夠的安全通道進出工作位置，以及確保所有危險邊緣均適當地安全圍封，如未能切實可行地提供有關措施，亦應為工人提供合適的全身式安全帶，並需持續繫於適當及穩固的繫穩點或獨立救生繩及防墮系統上，以保障工人高處工作安全。
levels.text_en: The Labour Department is highly concerned about a fatal work accident that happened in the afternoon inside a construction site in Kowloon City. A male employee, while working on the rooftop of a building under renovation, fell from a high point at the edge of the roof, and after being taken to hospital was confirmed dead. The department is very sad about this and extends deep condolences to the family. A spokesperson stated that after the accident the Labour Department immediately dispatched staff to the accident scene to launch an investigation, and has issued a 'Suspension Notice' to the contractor concerned, stopping use of that renovated building's rooftop until it is satisfied that the contractor has taken appropriate measures to remove the hazard, before work can resume. The Labour Department is investigating at full speed to determine the cause of the accident, ascertain the legal responsibility of those responsible, and propose improvement measures; if the investigation finds any violations, it will definitely handle them according to law. The Labour Department reminds that employers must take adequate preventive measures, including providing workers with appropriate and adequate safe access to and from the work location, and ensuring all dangerous edges are properly and safely fenced off; if such measures cannot be practicably provided, they should also provide workers with a suitable full-body safety harness, which must be continuously attached to an appropriate and secure anchor point or an independent lifeline and fall-arrest system, to protect workers' safety when working at height.

articles.summary_en: A workplace fatality in Kowloon City: a male worker fell from the roof edge of a building under renovation and died. The Labour Department is investigating and has ordered work on the roof to stop.

articles.title: 董敏莉
articles.summary: 董敏莉係香港女藝人，佢拍過好多電影同電視劇。

levels.text: 董敏莉係香港女藝人，1980年出世。佢喺2004年出道，初頭做歌手，之後就主要拍電影同電視劇。佢有名嘅電影包括《師奶唔易做》同埋《性工作者十日談》。佢喺2016年結咗婚，仲生咗一個女。
levels.text_en: Monie Tung is a Hong Kong female entertainer, born in 1980. She debuted in 2004, starting as a singer, and later mainly acted in films and TV dramas. Her well-known films include "No Easy Job for Housewives" and "Whispers and Moans." She married in 2016 and gave birth to a daughter.

levels.text: 董敏莉係香港女藝人，1980年11月喺香港出世。佢喺2004年出道，一開頭做歌手，之後主要係拍電影同電視劇。佢比較出名嘅電影作品，有《師奶唔易做》同《性工作者十日談》。讀書方面，佢中學讀聖公會林護紀念中學，大學就入咗香港大學文學院，主修法國文學。佢喺2016年同一位律師莊耀金結婚，生咗一個女，叫莊子子。除咗做演員，佢都做過唔少電視節目主持。
levels.text_en: Monie Tung is a Hong Kong female entertainer, born in Hong Kong in November 1980. She debuted in 2004, starting as a singer, then mainly acting in films and TV dramas. Her more famous film works include "No Easy Job for Housewives" and "Whispers and Moans." As for schooling, she attended SKH Lam Woo Memorial Secondary School, and at university entered the Faculty of Arts at the University of Hong Kong, majoring in French literature. In 2016 she married a lawyer named Chong Yiu-kam, and gave birth to a daughter named Chong Tsz-tsz. Besides being an actress, she has also hosted quite a few TV programs.

levels.text: 董敏莉係香港女藝人，1980年11月26號喺香港出世。佢喺2004年正式出道，初頭以歌手身份發展，之後就主要專注拍電影同電視劇。佢比較為人熟悉嘅電影作品，包括《師奶唔易做》同《性工作者十日談》，另外仲拍過《甜絲絲》、《傷城》、《游龍戲鳳》等等。讀書方面，佢中學就讀聖公會林護紀念中學，大學入咗香港大學文學院，主修法國文學。電視劇方面，佢曾經喺無線電視、亞洲電視、有線電視、香港電台同ViuTV演出過唔同角色。佢亦都主持過幾個電視節目。佢喺2016年同律師莊耀金結婚，育有一個女，叫莊子子。
levels.text_en: Monie Tung is a Hong Kong female entertainer, born in Hong Kong on 26 November 1980. She officially debuted in 2004, first developing as a singer, then mainly focusing on films and TV dramas. Her more familiar film works include "No Easy Job for Housewives" and "Whispers and Moans," and she also acted in "Sweet and Sour," "Confession of Pain," "Look for a Star" and so on. As for schooling, she attended SKH Lam Woo Memorial Secondary School, and at university entered the Faculty of Arts at the University of Hong Kong, majoring in French literature. In TV dramas, she has played various roles at TVB, ATV, Cable TV, RTHK and ViuTV. She has also hosted several TV programs. In 2016 she married the lawyer Chong Yiu-kam, and has a daughter named Chong Tsz-tsz.

levels.text: 董敏莉是香港女藝人，1980年11月在香港出生。她在2004年出道，起初做歌手，後來主要拍電影和電視劇。她較有名的電影，包括《師奶唔易做》和《性工作者十日談》。中學時，她讀聖公會林護紀念中學。之後她入讀香港大學文學院，主修法國文學。她也主持過一些電視節目。2016年，她和律師莊耀金結婚，並生了一個女兒，叫莊子子。
levels.text_en: Monie Tung is a Hong Kong female entertainer, born in Hong Kong in November 1980. She debuted in 2004, starting as a singer, later mainly acting in films and TV dramas. Her more famous films include "No Easy Job for Housewives" and "Whispers and Moans." During secondary school she attended SKH Lam Woo Memorial Secondary School. After that she entered the Faculty of Arts at the University of Hong Kong, majoring in French literature. She has also hosted some TV programs. In 2016 she married the lawyer Chong Yiu-kam and gave birth to a daughter named Chong Tsz-tsz.

levels.text: 董敏莉（Monie Tung，1980年11月26號—）係香港女藝人，2004年出道，初頭係歌手，之後主要拍電影同電視劇，出名電影作品包括《師奶唔易做》同《性工作者十日談》。 == 簡歷 == 董敏莉香港出世，中學讀聖公會林護紀念中學，大學讀香港大學文學院，主修法國文學。 董敏莉2016年同律師莊耀金結婚，育有一女莊子子。 == 演出作品 == === 電影 === 2003年：《新紮師姐》 2004年：《甜絲絲》飾 羅四喜 2005年：《半醉人間》 2005年：《AV》 2006年：《PG家長指引》 2006年：《鬼眼刑警》 2006年：《師奶唔易做》飾 Cherry 2006年：《傷城》 2007年：《性工作者十日談》 2007年：《單身部落》飾 美華 2007年：《危險人物》 2007年：《十分愛》飾 Mary 2008年：《七月好風》（獨立電影） 2008年：《無野之城》 2008年：《性工作者2我不賣身我賣子宮》 2009年：《游龍戲鳳》 2010年：《香港機密》 2015年: 《碟仙碟仙》飾 董祖兒 2015年: 《色模》 === 電視劇 === 2004年：無線電視電視劇《赤沙印記@四葉草.2》飾 方敏(Mon-mon) 2005年：台灣偶像劇《海豚愛上貓》 2006年：香港電台單元劇《小琴》 2006年：香港電台單元劇《歡樂滿屋》之 巡更 2006年：香港電台單元劇《左鄰右里III 滋家歌》 2007年：有線電視劇《補習天后》 飾 陸小魚 2008年：亞洲電視電視劇《火蝴蝶》 飾 霍心思 2010年：香港電台單元劇《火速救兵》 2012年：香港電台單元劇《非凡工程夢》飾 ：梁穎詩母(1967-1972)、高中同成年梁穎詩 2019年：ViuTV電視劇《假設性無罪》 飾 岑美珊 === 節目主持 === 2008年：有線電視《「峰」生水起精讀班》掌相篇（其他主持：蘇民峰） 2008-2009年：有線電視《高師傅美食俠客行》（其他主持：高榮新） 2009年：有線電視《高師傅美食傳奇》（其他主持：高榮新） 2012年：亞洲電視《娛樂CIA》 2016年：viuTV《即日上映》 == 攷 == == 出面網頁 == 董敏莉 董敏莉嘅Facebook頁 董敏莉/ 董敏莉嘅Instagram頁 董敏莉喺互聯網電影資料庫嘅資料 董敏莉喺虛擬國際權威檔案識別碼嘅資料 董敏莉喺TMDb嘅資料 董敏莉喺Google Knowledge Graph ID嘅資料
levels.text_en: Monie Tung (Monie Tung, 26 November 1980 – ) is a Hong Kong female entertainer who debuted in 2004, first a singer, then mainly acting in films and TV dramas; famous film works include "No Easy Job for Housewives" and "Whispers and Moans." == Biography == Monie Tung was born in Hong Kong, attended SKH Lam Woo Memorial Secondary School in secondary school, and studied at the Faculty of Arts at the University of Hong Kong, majoring in French literature. Monie Tung married the lawyer Chong Yiu-kam in 2016, and has a daughter named Chong Tsz-tsz. == Works == === Films === 2003: "The Attractive One"; 2004: "Sweet and Sour" as Lo Sze-hei; 2005: "Half Drunk"; 2005: "AV"; 2006: "PG Parental Guidance"; 2006: "Ghost Eye Detective"; 2006: "No Easy Job for Housewives" as Cherry; 2006: "Confession of Pain"; 2007: "Whispers and Moans"; 2007: "Single Blog" as Mei-wah; 2007: "Dangerous Person"; 2007: "Love Is Not All Around" as Mary; 2008: "July Good Wind" (independent film); 2008: "City Without Baseball"; 2008: "Whispers and Moans 2 I Don't Sell My Body I Sell My Womb"; 2009: "Look for a Star"; 2010: "Hong Kong Confidential"; 2015: "Ouija Board" as Tung Cho-yi; 2015: "Nude Model". === TV dramas === 2004: TVB drama "Split Second" as Fong Man (Mon-mon); 2005: Taiwan idol drama "The Dolphin Loves the Cat"; 2006: RTHK single-episode drama "Little Kam"; 2006: RTHK single-episode drama "Full House" – Patrol; 2006: RTHK single-episode drama "Neighbours III Home Sweet Home"; 2007: Cable TV drama "Tutor Queen" as Luk Siu-yu; 2008: ATV drama "Fire Butterfly" as Fok Sum-si; 2010: RTHK single-episode drama "Emergency Rescue"; 2012: RTHK single-episode drama "Extraordinary Engineering Dream" as Leung Wing-si's mother (1967-1972), and high-school and adult Leung Wing-si; 2019: ViuTV drama "Presumed Innocence" as Sum Mei-shan. === Program hosting === 2008: Cable TV "'Fung' Intensive Class" Face-reading section (co-host: So Man-fung); 2008-2009: Cable TV "Master Ko's Gourmet Journey" (co-host: Ko Wing-san); 2009: Cable TV "Master Ko's Gourmet Legend" (co-host: Ko Wing-san); 2012: ATV "Entertainment CIA"; 2016: ViuTV "Now Showing." == References == == External links == Monie Tung; Monie Tung's Facebook page; Monie Tung / Monie Tung's Instagram page; Monie Tung's entry in the Internet Movie Database; Monie Tung's entry in VIAF; Monie Tung's entry in TMDb; Monie Tung's entry in Google Knowledge Graph ID.

articles.title: 海關機場破獲行李藏毒案拘美籍漢　檢獲懷疑大麻花約值680萬元
articles.summary: 海關喺香港機場捉到一個美國男人，佢個行李箱藏住約33公斤懷疑大麻花，值約680萬元。

levels.text: 海關喺香港機場捉到一個34歲嘅美國男人。佢由美國紐約坐飛機嚟到香港，海關查佢行李嗰陣，喺佢兩個行李箱入面搵到約33公斤懷疑大麻花，估計值約680萬元，跟住就拉咗佢。海關叫大家小心，唔好為咗錢去做販毒呢啲事。
levels.text_en: Customs caught a 34-year-old American man at Hong Kong airport. He flew from New York, USA to Hong Kong. When Customs checked his luggage, they found about 33 kilograms of suspected cannabis flower in his two suitcases, estimated to be worth about 6.8 million dollars, and then arrested him. Customs urges everyone to be careful and not to get involved in drug trafficking for money.

levels.text: 海關喺香港機場偵破一宗行李藏毒案，捉到一個34歲嘅美國男旅客。佢今日由美國紐約坐飛機嚟到香港。海關清關嗰陣，喺佢兩個寄艙行李箱入面發現約33公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約680萬元，之後就拘捕咗佢。海關話會繼續加強打擊販毒活動，亦都呼籲市民提高警覺，唔好為咗錢去參與販毒，唔好接受人哋聘請或者委託運送受管制物品出入香港。
levels.text_en: Customs cracked a luggage drug-hiding case at Hong Kong airport, catching a 34-year-old American male traveller. He flew from New York, USA to Hong Kong today. During clearance, Customs found about 33 kilograms of suspected cannabis flower in his two checked suitcases, estimated market value about 6.8 million dollars, and then arrested him. Customs said it will continue to step up efforts against drug trafficking, and also urged the public to stay alert, not to get involved in drug trafficking for money, and not to accept being hired or entrusted by others to transport controlled items in and out of Hong Kong.

levels.text: 海關喺香港機場偵破一宗行李藏毒嘅販毒案件，檢獲約33公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約680萬元，並拘捕一名美國籍男子。一名34歲嘅美國籍男旅客今日由美國紐約飛抵香港。海關人員清關嗰陣，喺佢兩個寄艙行李箱入面發現該批懷疑大麻花，然後把該名男子拘捕。海關話會繼續根據情報分析，加強打擊販運毒品活動，同時呼籲市民提高警覺，切勿貪圖金錢利益而參與販毒，亦唔好接受任何人聘請或委託運送受管制物品進出香港。
levels.text_en: Customs cracked a luggage drug-hiding trafficking case at Hong Kong airport, seizing about 33 kilograms of suspected cannabis flower, estimated market value about 6.8 million dollars, and arrested an American man. A 34-year-old American male traveller flew into Hong Kong from New York, USA today. When Customs officers were doing clearance, they found this batch of suspected cannabis flower in his two checked suitcases, and then arrested the man. Customs said it will continue to strengthen the crackdown on drug trafficking activities based on intelligence analysis, and at the same time urged the public to stay alert, never to get involved in drug trafficking out of greed for money, and not to accept being hired or entrusted by anyone to transport controlled items in and out of Hong Kong.

levels.text: 海關在香港機場破獲一宗行李藏毒案。海關檢獲約33公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約680萬元，並拘捕一名美國籍男子。這名男子34歲，今日由美國紐約坐飛機來香港。海關清關時，在他兩個寄艙行李箱內發現這批毒品，然後將他拘捕。海關呼籲市民提高警覺，不要為了金錢而參與販毒，也不要替別人運送受管制物品進出香港。

levels.text: 海關在香港機場偵破一宗行李藏毒的販毒案件，檢獲約33公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約680萬元，並拘捕一名美國籍男子。 一名34歲的美國籍男旅客今日從美國紐約飛抵本港。海關人員清關時，在他的兩個寄艙行李箱內發現該批懷疑大麻花，然後把該名男子拘捕。 海關會繼續根據情報分析，加強打擊販運毒品活動，同時呼籲市民提高警覺，切勿貪圖金錢利益而參與販毒活動，不要接受任何人士聘請或委託運送受管制物品進出香港，亦切勿於未確定物品屬性的情況下，貿然協助他人運送。
levels.text_en: Customs cracked a luggage drug-hiding trafficking case at Hong Kong airport, seizing about 33 kilograms of suspected cannabis flower, estimated market value about 6.8 million dollars, and arrested an American man. A 34-year-old American male traveller flew into Hong Kong from New York, USA today. When Customs officers were doing clearance, they found this batch of suspected cannabis flower in his two checked suitcases, and then arrested the man. Customs will continue to strengthen the crackdown on drug trafficking activities based on intelligence analysis, and at the same time urged the public to stay alert, never to get involved in drug trafficking out of greed for money, not to accept being hired or entrusted by anyone to transport controlled items in and out of Hong Kong, and never to rashly help others transport items without confirming the nature of those items.

articles.title: 天文台料今日初時本港雨勢有時頗大　部分地區有機會水浸
articles.summary: 天文台話今日一開始落雨會好大，有啲地方可能會水浸。

levels.text: 天文台話，今日一開始落雨會有時好大，有啲地方可能會水浸，叫大家快啲做定準備，唔好蒙受損失。天文台又話，如果有需要，就會出暴雨警告，叫市民留意天文台最新嘅天氣消息。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says rain will sometimes be heavy from the start of the day today, and some places may flood. It urges everyone to prepare quickly so they don't suffer losses. The Observatory also says that if needed, it will issue a rainstorm warning, and it tells the public to pay attention to the Observatory's latest weather news.

levels.text: 天文台表示，因為受到一個好大嘅低壓槽影響，預料今日一開始，本港落雨會有時好大，有部分地區可能會出現水浸。天文台提醒市民，應該盡快做好適當嘅預防措施，以防止可能引致嘅損失。天文台又話，如果有需要，就會發出暴雨警告信號，或者局部地區大雨提示，叫市民留意天文台最新嘅天氣消息。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says that because of the influence of a large trough of low pressure, rain in Hong Kong is expected to be heavy at times from the start of the day today, and some areas may experience flooding. The Observatory reminds the public to take appropriate precautions as soon as possible, to prevent possible losses. The Observatory also says that if needed, it will issue a rainstorm warning signal, or a localized heavy rain alert, and tells the public to pay attention to the Observatory's latest weather news.

levels.text: 天文台表示，受到廣闊嘅低壓槽影響，預料今日初時，本港雨勢有時會頗大，部分地區有機會出現水浸。天文台提醒市民，應該盡快完成適當嘅預防措施，以防止可能引致嘅損失。天文台又話，喺有需要嘅時候，會發出暴雨警告信號，或者局部地區大雨提示，提醒市民留意天文台最新嘅天氣消息。市民出門之前，最好先睇清楚天氣情況，做好準備。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says that affected by a broad trough of low pressure, rain in Hong Kong is expected to be rather heavy at times early today, and some areas may experience flooding. The Observatory reminds the public to complete appropriate precautions as soon as possible, to prevent possible losses. The Observatory also says that when necessary, it will issue a rainstorm warning signal, or a localized heavy rain alert, reminding the public to pay attention to the Observatory's latest weather news. Before going out, the public should best check the weather situation clearly and prepare well.

levels.text: 天文台表示，受廣闊低壓槽影響，預料今日初時本港雨勢有時頗大。部分地區有機會出現水浸。天文台提醒市民，應盡快完成適當的預防措施，防止損失。天文台又說，有需要時會發出暴雨警告信號，或局部地區大雨提示。市民應留意天文台最新的天氣消息。

The Observatory reminds the public to complete appropriate precautions as soon as possible, to prevent losses. The Observatory also says that when necessary it will issue a rainstorm warning signal, or a localized heavy rain alert. The public should pay attention to the Observatory's latest weather news.

articles.title: 陳茂波：國債期貨上市具戰略意義
articles.summary: 陳茂波話中國國債期貨喺香港上市，對香港好有幫助。

levels.text: 中國國債期貨喺香港上市喇。財政司司長陳茂波話，三年前中央大力幫手，香港就有咗利率互換通，可以幫外面嘅投資者管理人民幣風險。而家國債期貨又上市，可以畀大家有多啲工具去管理風險。佢話呢件事對香港好有戰略意義，可以令香港做得更加好。
levels.text_en: China government bond futures are now listed in Hong Kong. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that three years ago, with strong help from the central government, Hong Kong got Swap Connect, which helps outside investors manage RMB risk. Now bond futures are also listed, giving everyone more tools to manage risk. He said this is very strategically meaningful for Hong Kong and can make Hong Kong do even better.

levels.text: 中國國債期貨喺香港上市喇。財政司司長陳茂波話，三年前喺中央大力支持下，香港推出咗利率互換通，畀境外投資者可以更方便噉管理人民幣利率風險。而家國債期貨又上市，為國債提供多啲可以交易、可以定價嘅離岸工具，令離岸人民幣產品嘅風險管理更加完整。佢仲話，呢件事對香港好有戰略意義。香港唔可以淨係做籌錢嘅中心，仲要做定價中心、風險管理中心，噉先可以鞏固同提升自己國際金融中心嘅地位。
levels.text_en: China government bond futures are now listed in Hong Kong. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that three years ago, with strong support from the central government, Hong Kong launched Swap Connect, letting offshore investors more conveniently manage RMB interest rate risk. Now bond futures are also listed, providing more tradable and priceable offshore tools for government bonds, making risk management of offshore RMB products more complete. He also said this is very strategically meaningful for Hong Kong. Hong Kong cannot only be a fundraising center; it must also be a pricing center and risk management center, so it can consolidate and enhance its status as an international financial center.

levels.text: 中國國債期貨喺香港上市。財政司司長陳茂波表示，三年前喺中央相關部委大力支持下，香港推出咗利率互換通，畀境外投資者可以更方便噉管理人民幣利率風險。而家國債期貨上市，為國債提供標準化、可交易、可定價嘅離岸對沖工具，令離岸人民幣固定收益產品嘅風險管理體系更加完整。佢指出，呢件事對香港好有戰略意義。香港要更加多元化發展，唔可以淨係做籌錢中心，仲要做定價中心、風險管理中心同資產配置中心。配合互聯互通深化，香港嘅角色將會由連接內地同國際市場，升級做雙向配置同雙向風險管理嘅樞紐。
levels.text_en: China government bond futures are listed in Hong Kong. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that three years ago, with strong support from relevant central ministries, Hong Kong launched Swap Connect, letting offshore investors more conveniently manage RMB interest rate risk. Now bond futures are listed, providing standardized, tradable and priceable offshore hedging tools for government bonds, making the risk management system for offshore RMB fixed-income products more complete. He pointed out this is very strategically meaningful for Hong Kong. Hong Kong needs more diversified development; it cannot only be a fundraising center but must also be a pricing center, risk management center, and asset allocation center. In line with the deepening of mutual connectivity, Hong Kong's role will upgrade from connecting the mainland and international markets to being a hub for two-way allocation and two-way risk management.

levels.text: 中國國債期貨在香港上市。財政司司長陳茂波表示，三年前在中央部委的支持下，香港推出了利率互換通，讓境外投資者更方便地管理人民幣利率風險。現在國債期貨上市，為國債提供可交易、可定價的離岸工具，令離岸人民幣產品的風險管理更完整。他指出，這對香港有戰略意義。香港不能只做籌資的中心，還要做定價中心、風險管理中心和資產配置中心。這樣香港的角色會由連接內地和國際市場，升級為雙向配置和雙向風險管理的樞紐。
levels.text_en: China government bond futures are listed in Hong Kong. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that three years ago, with support from central ministries, Hong Kong launched Swap Connect, letting offshore investors more conveniently manage RMB interest rate risk. Now bond futures are listed, providing tradable and priceable offshore tools for government bonds, making risk management of offshore RMB products more complete. He pointed out this is strategically meaningful for Hong Kong. Hong Kong cannot only be a fundraising center; it must also be a pricing center, risk management center, and asset allocation center. This way Hong Kong's role will upgrade from connecting the mainland and international markets to being a hub for two-way allocation and two-way risk management.

levels.text: 中國國債期貨在香港上市。財政司司長陳茂波表示，三年前在中央相關部委大力支持下，香港推出利率互換通，讓境外投資者可更便利地管理人民幣利率風險。現在國債期貨上市，為國債提供標準化、場內化、可交易、可定價的離岸對沖工具，讓離岸人民幣固定收益產品的風險管理體系更完整。   他指出，國債期貨上市對香港具戰略意義。香港要邁向更多元化發展，以鞏固提升國際金融中心地位，不只做籌融資的中心，還要做定價中心、風險管理中心、資產配置中心，國債期貨正好提升香港這些方面的功能和優勢，配合互聯互通的深化，香港的角色將會從連接內地和國際市場，進一步升級為雙向配置和雙向風險管理的樞紐。   以下是財政司司長陳茂波8月3日出席香港交易所中國國債期貨上市儀式的致辭：   尊敬的吳清主席（中國證券監督管理委員會主席）、尊敬的周霽主任（中央人民政府駐香港特別行政區聯絡辦公室主任）、黃天佑主席（證券及期貨事務監察委員會主席）、梁鳳儀總裁（證券及期貨事務監察委員會行政總裁）、唐家成主席（香港交易及結算所有限公司主席）、陳翊庭總裁（香港交易及結算所有限公司行政總裁）、余偉文總裁（香港金融管理局總裁）、各位嘉賓、各位朋友：    早上好。很高興出席今天國債期貨的上市儀式。首先，請容許我對遠道專程而來的吳清主席和中國證監會的朋友們表示最熱烈的歡迎，對中國證監會、中國人民銀行，以及相關中央部委長期以來對深化內地與香港金融市場互聯互通、鞏固提升香港國際金融中心地位的鼎力支持，表示最衷心的感謝！   國債期貨從醞釀到落實，經歷了一段時間的協調和準備，在多個中央部委和機構的全力支持、香港特區政府及相關監管機構的的同事的共同努力下，今天正式迎來上市交易。這固然是各方衷誠協作的成果，也反映着客觀條件的成熟。   宏觀背景是國家的經濟實力不斷增強，經濟政策和貨幣政策穩健。今年上半年我國貨物貿易進出口總額突破25萬億元人民幣，按年增長約17%，創歷史新高。新能源、人工智能、芯片等領域正在加速形成具有全球影響力的產業集群。這貿易與產業的發展，帶動了實質的人民幣跨境交易和使用場景，以及人民幣在離岸市場的管理需求。   此外，地緣政局和不明朗的外圍市場環境，也讓海內外投資者對長期持有人民幣資產的需求進一步增加。債券通是境外投資者進入內地債券市場的主要渠道，佔總體交易份額約三分之二。他們通過此渠道持有的中國債券規模，截至今年6月底已超過三萬億元人民幣，比九年前債券通剛開始時的規模多出近三倍。   正因為建立長期倉位，高效的風險管理工具必須相匹配。三年前，在中央相關部委的大力支持下，我們推出了利率互換通，讓境外投資者可以更便利地管理人民幣利率風險。而今天推出的國債期貨，正好補上另一塊關鍵拼圖：為中國國債提供標準化、場內化、可交易、可定價的離岸對
levels.text_en: China government bond futures are listed in Hong Kong. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that three years ago, with strong support from relevant central ministries, Hong Kong launched Swap Connect, letting offshore investors more conveniently manage RMB interest rate risk. Now bond futures are listed, providing standardized, exchange-traded, tradable and priceable offshore hedging tools for government bonds, making the risk management system for offshore RMB fixed-income products more complete. He pointed out that the listing of bond futures is strategically meaningful for Hong Kong. Hong Kong needs to move toward more diversified development to consolidate and enhance its status as an international financial center — not only being a fundraising center but also a pricing center, risk management center, and asset allocation center. Bond futures precisely enhance Hong Kong's functions and advantages in these areas, and in line with the deepening of mutual connectivity, Hong Kong's role will further upgrade from connecting the mainland and international markets to being a hub for two-way allocation and two-way risk management. The following is the speech by Financial Secretary Paul Chan at the HKEX China government bond futures listing ceremony on August 3: Respected Chairman Wu Qing (Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission), respected Director Zhou Ji (Director of the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the HKSAR), Chairman Wong Tin-yau (Chairman of the Securities and Futures Commission), CEO Julia Leung (CEO of the SFC), Chairman Carlson Tong (Chairman of HKEX), CEO Bonnie Chan (CEO of HKEX), CEO Eddie Yue (CEO of the HKMA), distinguished guests and friends: Good morning. I am very glad to attend today's bond futures listing ceremony. First, allow me to extend the warmest welcome to Chairman Wu Qing and friends from the CSRC who came specially from afar, and express my most sincere gratitude to the CSRC, the People's Bank of China, and relevant central ministries for their long-standing strong support in deepening mainland-Hong Kong financial market connectivity and consolidating and enhancing Hong Kong's status as an international financial center! From conception to implementation, bond futures went through a period of coordination and preparation, and today officially arrives at listing and trading with the full support of multiple central ministries and institutions and the joint efforts of colleagues at the HKSAR Government and relevant regulators. This is of course the fruit of sincere collaboration by all parties, and also reflects the maturity of objective conditions. The macro background is the country's continuously growing economic strength and steady economic and monetary policy. In the first half of this year China's total goods trade import and export exceeded 25 trillion yuan, up about 17% year-on-year, a record high. Fields like new energy, artificial intelligence and chips are accelerating the formation of globally influential industrial clusters. This trade and industrial development has driven real RMB cross-border transactions and usage scenarios, as well as demand for RMB management in offshore markets. In addition, geopolitics and an uncertain external market environment have further increased demand from domestic and foreign investors for holding RMB assets long-term. Bond Connect is the main channel for offshore investors to enter the mainland bond market, accounting for about two-thirds of total trading share. Chinese bonds held through this channel exceeded 3 trillion yuan by the end of June this year, nearly four times the scale when Bond Connect first began nine years ago. Precisely because of building long-term positions, efficient risk management tools must match. Three years ago, with strong support from relevant central ministries, we launched Swap Connect, letting offshore investors more conveniently manage RMB interest rate risk. And today's bond futures fill in another key piece of the puzzle: providing standardized, exchange-traded, tradable and priceable offshore [hedging tools] for China government bonds...

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan comments on the listing of China government bond futures in Hong Kong, framing it as a strategic step for the city's financial development. The final version includes his full speech at the HKEX listing ceremony.
